fields.title: Abasajja n’Abakazi Abaawaayo Byonna
fields.description: “Okugoberera Yesu kuntwalako ki ddala?” oyinza okubuuza. Okusoma kuno okw’okufumiitiriza kukuleeta maaso ku maaso n’abantu kkumi ab’ettutumu abaddamu omulanga ogwo nga tebabala muwendo gwagwo. Okuva ku myaka egy’amakumi William Carey gye yamala mu Buyindi okutuuka ku kwewaayo kwa Jim Elliot okw’enkomerero, zuula okukkiriza okw’amazima okw’ekitume okwanyeenya amawanga.
fields.hook: Omuzannyi wa kiriketi eyagaba obugagga bwe bwonna, n’abalala mwenda abaagoberera Yesu ka kibe kya muwendo ki.

qa.question: Ekitabo Abasajja n’Abakazi Abaawaayo Byonna kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kusoma kwa kufumiitiriza okuleeta omusomi maaso ku maaso n’abantu kkumi abaddamu omulanga gwa Kristo nga tebabala muwendo — okuva ku myaka egy’amakumi William Carey gye yamala mu Buyindi okutuuka ku kuttibwa kwa Jim Elliot. Nga kibuuza Yesu okumugoberera kye kitwalako ddala, ekitabo kiraga okukkiriza kwabwe okw’amazima okw’ekitume n’okwewaayo kwabwe, okusoomooza n’okuzzaamu omusomi amaanyi okwewaayo kwe kumu n’omutima gwe gwonna.

qa.question: Kibuuzo ki ekitabo kye kibuuza omusomi?
qa.answer: “Okugoberera Yesu kuntwalako ki ddala?” Okusoma kwonna kwazimbibwa ku kibuuzo ekyo, nga kukozesa obulamu kkumi obw’okwewaayo okujjuvu okukinyweza. Mu kifo ky’okuleka omusomi okumatira n’okukkiriza okw’emirembe era okw’ekitundu, kimuleeta mu maaso g’abantu abaawaayo byonna, ne kibuuza omulanga ng’ogwo kye gwandibadde gutegeeza mu bulamu bwe ye.

qa.question: Bantu ki abamu ekitabo be kisoma ku bulamu bwabwe?
qa.answer: Mu bo mulimu William Carey, “taata w’obuminsani obw’omulembe guno,” eyamala emyaka egy’amakumi mu Buyindi, ne Jim Elliot, omuminsani omuvubuka eyattibwa abantu ba Waodani mu Ecuador. Ekitabo kikuŋŋaanya abantu kkumi ng’abo, okwewaayo kwabwe kwe kwabaggyako emirembe, obukuumi, oba obulamu bwennyini, ne kiggya mu buli omu ku bo ebyokuyiga eby’okukkiriza okwanyeenya amawanga.

qa.question: Ekitabo kitegeeza ki bwe kyogera ku kukkiriza “okw’ekitume”?
qa.answer: Okukkiriza okufaanana okw’abatume — okw’omutima gwonna, okw’okwewaayo, okutatya muwendo, okwetegefu okuleka byonna era n’okufiira Kristo n’enjiri ye. Ekitabo kiraga obulamu buno kkumi ng’ebyokulabirako eby’omulembe guno eby’okwewaayo okwo okw’ekyasa ekyasooka, nga kiyita omusomi okuva mu Bukristaayo obw’obuwoomi n’obw’empisa obwereere, okuyingira mu kwewaayo okw’amazima okw’abo abaawaayo byonna ddala.

qa.question: Kino kitabo kya byafaayo oba kya kufumiitiriza?
qa.answer: Byombi — kusoma kwa kufumiitiriza okwazimbibwa ku bulamu kkumi. Kinyumya emboozi zaabwe, naye bulijjo okunyweza ekyokulabirako kyabwe ku mutima n’ekkubo ly’omusomi yennyini, nga kibuuza okugoberera Yesu kye kwandimutwaliddeko. Bwe kityo obulamu buno buweereza ekigendererwa eky’okufumiitiriza: si kwewuunyibwa kwokka, wabula okusoomooza n’okukyusa okwewaayo kw’omusomi.

qa.question: Ekitabo kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Kyawandiikirwa Omukristaayo yenna eyetegefu okusoomoozebwa ku muwendo gw’amazima ogw’okubeera omuyigirizwa, era akwatibwako ebyokulabirako by’abo abaagusasula. Kyogera naddala eri abakkiriza abawulira nti okukkiriza kwabwe kufuuse kwa buwoomi, nga kiraga abasajja n’abakazi abaawaayo byonna ng’okunenya era ng’ekisikiriza eri okwewaayo okw’omunda ennyo.

qa.question: Kikwatagana kitya n’ebitabo ebirala ebiri mu kibinja kye kimu?
qa.answer: Kya mu kibinja ky’ebitabo eby’okufumiitiriza ebikolagana, ebikuŋŋaanya obulamu obw’omuwendo omunene okusikiriza omusomi okukkiriza okw’omutima gwonna. Ng’ebimu bitunuulira okusaba oba omulimu gw’obusumba, kino kitunuulira okwewaayo n’omuwendo gw’okugoberera Kristo, nga kiraga abantu kkumi abataalaba muwendo gwonna nga munene nnyo.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’atwala obulamu obwo kkumi kimu ku kimu era ng’aleka buli bumu okunyweza ku ye ekibuuzo ekikulu eky’ekitabo. Olw’okuba kusoma kwa kufumiitiriza okugenderera okusoomooza n’okuyigiriza, kusinga okubala ebibala bwe kusomebwa mu kusaba era ne kussibwa mu nkola, obulamu bumu ku bumu, okusinga okusomebwa olw’emboozi zokka.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Abaatumwa Abaagaana Okukoma
fields.body_html:
Waliwo ekibuuzo ekiri mu mutima gw’okukkiriza kw’Abakristaayo eddiini ey’okwejjalabya ky’efuba ennyo okwewala: okugoberera Yesu kitwala ki ddala? Si Bukristaayo obulongooseddwa obw’ekitongole — obwo obukwanaganya obulungi n’essaawa emu ku Sande ne butabaako kye busaba mu nnaku endala ez’omu wiiki — wabula Obukristaayo obw’olubereberye, obutaliiko kye bubikkiddwako, obw’abatume, Mukama eyazuukira mw’awa ekiragiro kye, abayigirizwa be ne bakigondera ddala. Abasajja n’abakazi ekkumi abali mu kitabo kino baddamu ekibuuzo ekyo n’obulamu bwabwe, era eby’okuddamu bye baawa tebyali byangu. Baagaba obugagga bwabwe, baaziika abaami n’abakyala baabwe, baagumira okusibibwa mu makomera, baawona ebikolwa eby’obukambwe, baasomoka ennyanja ennene, era abamu ku bo baawaayo emibiri gyabwe ddala ku lw’omulimu. Baatumibwa, ne bagenda, era tebaayimirira.

Ekiragiro ekyabumba obulamu bwabwe kye kimu n’ekiragiro ekibadde kibumba ekkanisa bulijjo mu biseera byayo eby’obwesigwa obusingayo. Nga tannalinnya mu ggulu, Kristo eyazuukira yakuŋŋaanya abayigirizwa be n’abawa ekiragiro ekyo ekitasazibwangamu: “Kale mugende mufuule abantu bonna mu nsi zonna, abayigirizwa nga mubabatiza mu linnya lya Kitaffe, Omwana era Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe, era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo.” (Matayo 28:19–20). Ebigambo bino bisindise abasajja n’abakazi okutuuka ku nkomerero z’ensi mu buli mulembe okuva lwe byasooka okwogerwa. Obulamu ekkumi obuli mu kitabo kino bwe by’okuddamu ekkumi eri ekiragiro ekyo — engeri kkumi ez’enjawulo Ekiragiro Ekinene gye kyavvuunulwamu mu kitundu ky’ensi, mu buwangwa, ne mu kiseera ekyenjawulo Katonda kye yali ategekedde buli omu ku bo.

Nga tannalinnya, Yesu era yannyonnyola obunene bw’omulimu ogwo mu ngeri entuufu ennyo, ne watabaawo nsonda ya nsi n’emu esigala ebweru waagwo: “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Ebigambo “ku nkomerero z’ensi” tebyali bya kufaananya bufaananya eri abasajja n’abakazi abali mu kitabo kino. William Carey yamala emyaka amakumi ana mu gumu mu Buyindi. David Livingstone yayingira munda mu masekkati ga Afirika, ekitundu ekyali tekinnaba kuteekebwa ku maapu, n’afiira eyo ng’afukamidde. C.T. Studd yaweereza ku ssemazinga basatu. Catherine Booth yatwala enjiri mu nguudo z’ebitundu by’abaavu ebyali eby’akabi ennyo mu London ey’omu biseera bya Kabaka Omukazi Victoria. Enkomerero z’ensi, eri buli omu ku bo, zaali bifo bya ddala ku maapu — ebifo ebirina amannya, n’abantu abalina obwenyi, Enjiri gye yali tennatuuka.

Kiki ekyateekateeka abantu bano ekkumi okubeera n’obulamu obwo obw’ekitalo obw’okwefiiriza mu mulimu gw’obuminsani? Tekyali buvumu obusinga obw’abalala wadde obugumiikiriza obw’enjawulo, newankubadde nga byombi byaliwo. Kwali kukkiriza okunywevu mu njigiriza, nti abo abatali mu Kristo babuze, n’amaanyi agaabakaka agaava mu kukkiriza okwo.

Buli omu ku bo, mu ngeri ye, yali anywedde ensonga z’omutume Pawulo n’awulira obuzito bwazo bwonna obw’empisa. Baategeera ekyali mu kabi — nti emabega wa buli muntu atawulirangako njiri waaliyo emmeeme ey’omuwendo ogw’olubeerera, era nti ekibuuzo ky’aliba gy’alibeera emirembe gyonna tekyali kya ndowooza ya ddiini ey’okwejjalabya, wabula kya mazima agookya, ag’amangu, agakyusa obulamu.

Abo abaali bakkiriza ddala tebaasobola kubuusa maaso, nga bateredde, olujegere lw’ensonga Pawulo lwe yalambika mu Abaruumi: “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa? Ekyawandiikibwa nga bwe kigamba nti, ‘Ebigere by’abo abategeeza amawulire amalungi, nga birungi.’” (Abaruumi 10:14–15). Olujegere luva ku kuwulira ne lutuuka ku kukkiriza, ku kukoowoola, okutuuka ku bulokozi — era ku ntandikwa y’olujegere olwo wayimiriddewo oyo atumiddwa. Abantu bano ekkumi baali mpeta mu lujegere olwo. Be baali ebigere ebirungi. Era olujegere terwakutuka.

Okwefiiriza obulamu buno kwe bwalimu tekwali kintu kya ku mabbali mu mulimu, wabula kitundu kyagwo ekitayinza kwawulwamu. Pawulo yannyonnyola obuweereza bwe ye kennyini n’ebigambo buli omu ku bano ekkumi bye yandiwandiise ku ye yennyini: “obulamu bwange sibutwala kuba nga kya muwendo gye ndi, ndyoke ntuukirize omulimu gwange, n’obuweereza bwe nnaweebwa Mukama waffe Yesu, okutegeezanga Enjiri ey’ekisa kya Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:24). Okutwala obulamu bwo nga si bwa muwendo gy’oli si kwegomba kufa wadde okwekyawa; kwe kusumululwa kw’emmeeme ezudde ekintu ekisinga omuwendo awatali kigero okusinga okukuuma obuweerero bwayo. Abantu bano ekkumi baali bazudde ekintu ekyo. Baakiyita enjiri y’ekisa, era baawaayo buli kye baalina okugibunyisa.

Essuula zino bifaananyi bya mazima, si bibumbe bya kusinzibwa. Abasajja n’abakazi b’ogenda okusisinkana mu mpapula zino tebaali bantu basukkulumye ku buntu abataakwatibwangako kutya, kubuusabuusa, kiwuubaalo, wadde okulemererwa. Emyaka omusanvu egyasooka William Carey gye yamala mu Buyindi tegyaleeta muntu n’omu eyakyuka. Obufumbo bwa David Livingstone bwasasika olw’ebizibu by’obuminsani bwe. Okwefiiriza kwa C.T. Studd okw’obuzira kwagenda wamu n’ebizibu bye ku bubwe abawandiisi b’ebyafaayo bye bye batabikkirira. Jim Elliot yafa ku myaka amakumi abiri mu munaana nga tannalaba muntu n’omu akyuka mu bantu be yali agenze okutuukako. Ekyafuula obulamu buno obw’ekitalo tekwali butabaamu bunafu bwa buntu, wabula okubeerawo kwa Katonda akolera mu bantu abanafu abakyali beetegefu, wadde nga waliwo byonna.

Obulamu buno ekkumi buggyewo buli kyekwaso kyonna eky’okubeera n’obulamu obw’okwejjalabya, obw’okwefaako wekka, obw’eddiini ekuumibwa mu kyama. Bukuzuukusemu ekibuuzo buli mulembe gw’Abakristaayo abeesimbu kye gulina okuddamu buggya: olw’ebyo Kristo by’akoze, olw’ebyo ensi by’eyetaaga, era olw’okuba nti obulamu bumu bwe bwokka buli omu ku ffe bw’alina — nze nkola ki n’obwange? Okuddamu ekibuuzo kino tekubangako kwa mangu nnyo okusinga bwe kuli kati.

fields.title: William Carey — Omukozi w’Engatto Eyakyusa Ensi
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

William Carey yazaalibwa nga 17 Agusito, 1761, mu Paulerspury, Northamptonshire, mu Bungereza, nga mutabani w’omulusi w’engoye eyafuuka oluvannyuma omusomesa w’essomero ly’ekyalo. Yateekebwa okuyiga omulimu gw’omukozi w’engatto, ne yeesomesa yekka olw’okwefuga okw’enjawulo ennyo, n’amanya Olulattini, Oluyonaani, Olwebbulaniya, Oluholandi n’Olufalansa ng’akyatunga engatto, era n’afuuka omusumba w’Ababatisti mu 1786. Mu 1792 yafulumya “An Enquiry into the Obligations of Christians to Use Means for the Conversion of the Heathens” — okunnyonnyola okwategekebwa obulungi okw’empapula 87, okulaga nti Ekiragiro Ekikulu kyateeka obuvunaanyizibwa ku buli mulembe gw’Abakristaayo okutuuka ku buli ggwanga eritannatuukibwako mu nsi yonna. Mu mwaka ogwo gwe gumu n’ayambako okutandikawo Baptist Missionary Society, n’asaabala okugenda e Buyindi mu 1793. Teyaddayo Bungereza nate. Yamala emyaka amakumi ana mu gumu mu Buyindi, n’avvuunula Bayibuli mu Lubengali, mu Lusanskiriti, ne mu nnimi endala n’enjogera amakumi abiri mu musanvu, n’atandikawo Serampore College, n’alwanyisa sati (okwokya bannamwandu) n’okutta abaana abawere, era n’atandikawo ekibiina ky’abaminsani Abapulotesitanti ekyasooka eky’omulembe guno. Yafa mu 1834 ng’alina emyaka nsanvu mu ebiri, n’aziikibwa mu Buyindi.

Okulaba kwe ku Buweereza bw’Obuminsani n’Okwefiiriza

William Carey teyakoma ku kubuulira Kiragiro Kikulu kyokka — yakiwolereza, n’akisengeka, n’akissaamu ensimbi, era n’akiraga mu bulamu bwe. Ekikulu ekyava mu “Enquiry” ye kwali kumenyaamenya empaka ezaali zissibwamu ekitiibwa mu Bakalvini b’omu kiseera kye: nti singa Katonda yali ayagala okulokola abakaafiiri, yandibalokodde awatali kukozesa bantu. Mukama w’amakungula, yimusa mu mulembe gwaffe abasajja n’abakazi abalina obukakanyavu obutukuvu nga obwa Carey — abanaasimba awatamerangako kintu, abanaavvuunula awatannabaawo Kigambo, era abanaagumiikiriza emyaka emingi egy’ennimiro enzibu nga tebadda nnyuma.

Bwe tweyimbalaza ne tunoonya ensonga ez’obutakola, tusirise n’obwetaavu obw’amaanyi obw’abo abatannatuukibwako enjiri. Era omuliro bwe guzikiriza omulimu gwaffe, tuwe ekisa okutandika buggya.

Amiina.

fields.title: David Livingstone — Omuzuuli w’Ensi Ataalekera Awo Kugenda
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

David Livingstone yazaalibwa nga 19 ogw’okusatu, 1813, e Blantyre mu Sikotilandi, ng’ye mwana ow’okubiri ku baana musanvu mu maka amaavu naye nga ga Bakristaayo abeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda. Okuva ku myaka kkumi yakolanga mu kkolero ery’okuluka ppamba, n’eyesomesa yekka akawungeezi ng’ebitabo bye abisimbye ku kyuma kye eky’okuluka, era oluvannyuma n’asomera obusawo e Glasgow. Mu 1840 yasaabala okugenda e Afirika ng’atumiddwa ekibiina kya London Missionary Society, era n’amala emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu egyaddirira ng’anoonyereza, ng’akuba maapu, era ng’abuulira enjiri munda mu ssemazinga wa Afirika, n’obunyiikivu obwewuunyisa n’abo bennyini abaamussangamu ekitiibwa. Yakola engendo ssatu ennene ez’okunoonyereza, n’aggulawo ebitundu ebinene eby’amasekkati ga Afirika eri ensi ey’ebweru, era n’afuuka omuzuuli w’ensi eyasinga okumanyika mu mulembe gwe. Era ye yali eddoboozi eryasinga okunyiikira n’okuvaamu ebibala mu kulwanyisa obusuubuzi bw’abaddu mu Afirika mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda. Yasangibwa ng’afudde ng’afukamidde mu kusaba, mu kayumba mu kyalo ky’Omukulu Chitambo, mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Zambia, nga Mayi 1, 1873. Abaweereza be Abafirika, abaali bamwagala ennyo, baggyamu omutima gwe ne baguziika mu ttaka lya Afirika lye yawaayo obulamu bwe okulituukako, oluvannyuma ne basitula omulambo gwe ogwali gukuumiddwa obutavunda ne bagutambuza mayiro lukumi mu bina okutuuka ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, alyoke aziikibwe mu Westminster Abbey.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buminsani n’Obuweereza obw’Okwefiiriza

Okwolesebwa kwa Livingstone ku buminsani kwali kwesigamiziddwa ku kukkiriza okwandirabise ng’okwekontana eri bangi ku abo abaamuwagira: nti engeri esinga obulungi ey’okuggulawo Afirika eri enjiri teyali ya kusimba bifo bya buminsani ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, wabula okuyingira munda mu nsi eyali tennakubibwa maapu, okukola enkolagana n’abantu abaaliyo, okusaanyaawo obusuubuzi bw’abaddu obwali buzikiriza ssemazinga, oluvannyuma enjiri n’eyitira mu kkubo lye yali aggudde. Ekigendererwa kino eky’emirundi esatu yakiyita “C ssatu”: Christianity, Commerce, ne Civilization — kwe kugamba, Obukristaayo, Obusuubuzi n’Obuntu obukulaakulana — nga kino yali ategeeza nti okulangirira enjiri tekwawukana ku kuteekawo embeera abantu mwe basobola okukulaakulana.

Amaanyi agaasika obuweereza bwa Livingstone bwonna obw’obuminsani kwali kwolesebwa kwa ssemazinga omujjudde abantu abaali tebannawulira linnya lya Kristo — n’okukkiriza kwe okutanyeenyezeka nti Katonda yali tabeerabidde. Yali anywezezza ekisuubizo kya Isaaya ekinene eky’obuminsani: “Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo. Nzija kukufuula ekitangaala eri abamawanga, olyoke oleete obulokozi bwange eri ensi yonna.” (Isaaya 49:6). Eri Bungereza ey’omu mulembe gwa Victoria, Afirika ye yali enkomerero y’ensi. Livingstone yagaana okukkiriza nti yali wala nnyo obulokozi Isaaya bwe yasuubiza ne butasobola kugituukako. Yagenda okwekakasa, era n’amala emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu ng’alaga nti si bwe kiri.

Endowooza ye ku kwefiiriza mu buminsani yakolebwa mu bufiirwa obwamutuukako emirundi n’emirundi mu buweereza bwe. Yafiirwa obulamu bwe obulungi — omusujja gw’ensiri gwamukwata emirundi egisoba mu asatu, era oluvannyuma n’alwala ekiddukano ky’omusaayi, okuvaamu omusaayi, n’endwadde endala nnyingi ezaamufuula, mu myaka gye egy’enkomerero, ekisiikirize ky’omubiri gwe ogw’edda. Yafiirwa mukazi we, Mary, eyafiira mu Afirika mu 1862, ng’akomyewo okuva e Bungereza okubeera naye nate. Yafiirwa banne be yali akola nabo, emikutu egyamuleeteranga ebyetaago, era emirundi egiwerako n’ekkubo lye — ng’abuliddwa ddala mu masekkati ga Afirika nga tamanyi w’ali. Naye teyafiirwa kukkiriza kwe nti obuminsani bwali bugwana omuwendo gwonna gwe bwamusaba. Yanywerera ku bujulirwa bwa Pawulo: “Tunyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye ne tutabetenteka. Ne tweraliikirira, naye ne tutazirika. Tuyigganyizibwa, naye Katonda tatuleka. Tusuulibwa wansi, naye ne tutabetentuka” (2 Abakkolinso 4:8–9). Ebigambo ebisooka byonna yabiyitamu. Eby’okubiri tewali na kimu kyamutuukako.

Okuwakanya kwe okw’amaanyi obusuubuzi bw’abaddu kye kimu ku bikolwa eby’obuminsani ebyasinga okuba eby’omugaso mu buweereza bwe. Yategeera — nga William Wilberforce bwe yali ategedde omulembe ogwamusooka — nti enjiri erangirira nti buli mmeeme y’omuntu erina ekitiibwa kye kimu mu maaso ga Katonda teyinza n’akatono kutabagana na nkola egula n’etunda emmeeme ezo. Yawandiika ng’asinziira mu masekkati ga Afirika ku bye yali alabye, n’obusungu obwakuma omuliro mu ndowooza z’abantu ba Bungereza, era ne kiyamba okuleetawo amateeka agaakoma ku busuubuzi bw’abaddu mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika. Yali akola Ebyawandiikibwa kye byalagira: “Yogereranga abo abatasobola kweyogerera, otunulenga mu nsonga z’abo bonna abaasigala ettayo. Yogera olamulenga n’obwenkanya, olwanirirenga abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu.” (Engero 31:8–9). Eri Livingstone, okulangirira enjiri n’okulwanirira obwenkanya bwali buweereza bumu.

Mu myaka gye egy’enkomerero, Livingstone yabula ddala mu masekkati ga Afirika — ensi ey’ebweru n’emala emyaka nga temanyi w’ali — era olugendo olumanyiddwa ennyo olwa Henry Morton Stanley olw’okumunoonya lwavaamu okusisinkana okumu ku kwasinga okumanyika mu byafaayo by’okunoonyereza ensi. Stanley bwe yamala n’amusanga mu 1871 e Ujiji, yamusaba amuzzeeyo ewaabwe e Bungereza. Livingstone yagaana.

Yali tannamaliriza. Yawandiikira muwala we nti: “Ndi muminsani, mu mutima ne mu mmeeme. Katonda yalina Omwana omu yekka, era Ye yali muminsani era musawo.

Ndi kifaananyi kye ekinafu ennyo, ddala ekinafu, oba njagala okuba bwe ntyo, naye mu buweereza buno mwe nsuubira okubeera omulamu; era mu bwo mwe njagala okufiira.”

Era mu bwo mwe yafiira. Obulamu bwe bwalaga byonna Yokaana by’ayogera ku Kigambo okufuuka omuntu: “Kigambo n’afuuka omubiri, n’abeera mu ffe” (Yokaana 1:14). Livingstone yabeera mu bantu be yali azze okutuusaako enjiri. Era yaziikibwa mu bo.

Okufa kwe ng’afukamidde mu kusaba, mu ndowooza y’abo abaasinga okumumanya, kwe kwali okubuulira okwasinga okukwata ku mitima mu byonna bye yali abuulidde. Obuweereza bwe obw’obuminsani yabutambuza ng’afukamidde mu kyama, era ng’ayimiridde mu lwatu — embeera zino zombi nga tezaawukana, emu ng’ewanirira ginnaayo. Okutuusa ku nkomerero, yali oyo eyatumibwa ataddayo nnyuma, kubanga ekisuubizo ky’Oyo eyamutuma yakikkiriza nga bwe kiri ddala: “Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo” (Matayo 28:20). Olunaku ensi ye lwe yaggwaawo lwamutuukirira mu kayumba ak’ebitoomi mu Zambia.

Era ekisuubizo kyanywera.

Essaala

Okuva ku myaka kkumi yakolanga mu kkolero ery’okuluka ppamba, n’eyesomesa yekka akawungeezi ng’ebitabo bye abisimbye ku kyuma kye eky’okuluka, era oluvannyuma n’asomera obusawo e Glasgow. Mu 1840 yasaabala okugenda e Afirika ng’atumiddwa ekibiina kya London Missionary Society, era n’amala emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu egyaddirira ng’anoonyereza, ng’akuba maapu, era ng’abuulira enjiri munda mu ssemazinga wa Afirika, n’obunyiikivu obwewuunyisa n’abo bennyini abaamussangamu ekitiibwa. Yakola engendo ssatu ennene ez’okunoonyereza, n’aggulawo ebitundu ebinene eby’amasekkati ga Afirika eri ensi ey’ebweru, era n’afuuka omuzuuli w’ensi eyasinga okumanyika mu mulembe gwe. Era ye yali eddoboozi eryasinga okunyiikira n’okuvaamu ebibala mu kulwanyisa obusuubuzi bw’abaddu mu Afirika mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda. Yasangibwa ng’afudde ng’afukamidde mu kusaba, mu kayumba mu kyalo ky’Omukulu Chitambo, mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Zambia, nga Mayi 1, 1873. Abaweereza be Abafirika, abaali bamwagala ennyo, baggyamu omutima gwe ne baguziika mu ttaka lya Afirika lye yawaayo obulamu bwe okulituukako, oluvannyuma ne basitula omulambo gwe ogwali gukuumiddwa obutavunda ne bagutambuza mayiro lukumi mu bina okutuuka ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, alyoke aziikibwe mu Westminster Abbey. Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buminsani n’Obuweereza obw’Okwefiiriza Okwolesebwa kwa Livingstone ku buminsani kwali kwesigamiziddwa ku kukkiriza okwandirabise ng’okwekontana eri bangi ku abo abaamuwagira: nti engeri esinga obulungi ey’okuggulawo Afirika eri enjiri teyali ya kusimba bifo bya buminsani ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, wabula okuyingira munda mu nsi eyali tennakubibwa maapu, okukola enkolagana n’abantu abaaliyo, okusaanyaawo obusuubuzi bw’abaddu obwali buzikiriza ssemazinga, oluvannyuma enjiri n’eyitira mu kkubo lye yali aggudde. Ekigendererwa kino eky’emirundi esatu yakiyita “C ssatu”: Christianity, Commerce, ne Civilization — kwe kugamba, Obukristaayo, Obusuubuzi n’Obuntu obukulaakulana — nga kino yali ategeeza nti okulangirira enjiri tekwawukana ku kuteekawo embeera abantu mwe basobola okukulaakulana. Amaanyi agaasika obuweereza bwa Livingstone bwonna obw’obuminsani kwali kwolesebwa kwa ssemazinga omujjudde abantu abaali tebannawulira linnya lya Kristo — n’okukkiriza kwe okutanyeenyezeka nti Katonda yali tabeerabidde. Yali anywezezza ekisuubizo kya Isaaya ekinene eky’obuminsani: “Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo. Nzija kukufuula ekitangaala eri abamawanga, olyoke oleete obulokozi bwange eri ensi yonna.” (Isaaya 49:6). Eri Bungereza ey’omu mulembe gwa Victoria, Afirika ye yali enkomerero y’ensi. Livingstone yagaana okukkiriza nti yali wala nnyo obulokozi Isaaya bwe yasuubiza ne butasobola kugituukako. Yagenda okwekakasa, era n’amala emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu ng’alaga nti si bwe kiri. Endowooza ye ku kwefiiriza mu buminsani yakolebwa mu bufiirwa obwamutuukako emirundi n’emirundi mu buweereza bwe. Yafiirwa obulamu bwe obulungi — omusujja gw’ensiri gwamukwata emirundi egisoba mu asatu, era oluvannyuma n’alwala ekiddukano ky’omusaayi, okuvaamu omusaayi, n’endwadde endala nnyingi ezaamufuula, mu myaka gye egy’enkomerero, ekisiikirize ky’omubiri gwe ogw’edda. Yafiirwa mukazi we, Mary, eyafiira mu Afirika mu 1862, ng’akomyewo okuva e Bungereza okubeera naye nate. Yafiirwa banne be yali akola nabo, emikutu egyamuleeteranga ebyetaago, era emirundi egiwerako n’ekkubo lye — ng’abuliddwa ddala mu masekkati ga Afirika nga tamanyi w’ali. Naye teyafiirwa kukkiriza kwe nti obuminsani bwali bugwana omuwendo gwonna gwe bwamusaba. Yanywerera ku bujulirwa bwa Pawulo: “Tunyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye ne tutabetenteka. Ne tweraliikirira, naye ne tutazirika. Tuyigganyizibwa, naye Katonda tatuleka. Tusuulibwa wansi, naye ne tutabetentuka” (2 Abakkolinso 4:8–9). Ebigambo ebisooka byonna yabiyitamu. Eby’okubiri tewali na kimu kyamutuukako. Okuwakanya kwe okw’amaanyi obusuubuzi bw’abaddu kye kimu ku bikolwa eby’obuminsani ebyasinga okuba eby’omugaso mu buweereza bwe. Yategeera — nga William Wilberforce bwe yali ategedde omulembe ogwamusooka — nti enjiri erangirira nti buli mmeeme y’omuntu erina ekitiibwa kye kimu mu maaso ga Katonda teyinza n’akatono kutabagana na nkola egula n’etunda emmeeme ezo. Yali akola Ebyawandiikibwa kye byalagira: “Yogereranga abo abatasobola kweyogerera, otunulenga mu nsonga z’abo bonna abaasigala ettayo. Yogera olamulenga n’obwenkanya, olwanirirenga abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu.” (Engero 31:8–9). Eri Livingstone, okulangirira enjiri n’okulwanirira obwenkanya bwali buweereza bumu. Katonda yalina Omwana omu yekka, era Ye yali muminsani era musawo. Ndi kifaananyi kye ekinafu ennyo, ddala ekinafu, oba njagala okuba bwe ntyo, naye mu buweereza buno mwe nsuubira okubeera omulamu; era mu bwo mwe njagala okufiira.” Era mu bwo mwe yafiira. Obulamu bwe bwalaga byonna Yokaana by’ayogera ku Kigambo okufuuka omuntu: “Kigambo n’afuuka omubiri, n’abeera mu ffe” (Yokaana 1:14). Livingstone yabeera mu bantu be yali azze okutuusaako enjiri. Era yaziikibwa mu bo. Okufa kwe ng’afukamidde mu kusaba, mu ndowooza y’abo abaasinga okumumanya, kwe kwali okubuulira okwasinga okukwata ku mitima mu byonna bye yali abuulidde. Obuweereza bwe obw’obuminsani yabutambuza ng’afukamidde mu kyama, era ng’ayimiridde mu lwatu — embeera zino zombi nga tezaawukana, emu ng’ewanirira ginnaayo. Okutuusa ku nkomerero, yali oyo eyatumibwa ataddayo nnyuma, kubanga ekisuubizo ky’Oyo eyamutuma yakikkiriza nga bwe kiri ddala: “Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo” (Matayo 28:20). fields.title: Catherine Booth — Omubuulizi Eyatwala Enjiri mu Nguudo
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Catherine Mumford Booth yazaalibwa nga January 17, 1829, mu Ashbourne, Derbyshire, mu Bungereza. Yali muwala w’omubuulizi wa Methodist atali musumba mukulu, era okukkiriza kwe kwabumba okukwe okuva mu buto bwe. Yafumbirwa William Booth mu 1855, era bombi wamu ne bazimba ekyagenda okufuuka Salvation Army — ekimu ku bibiina by’obuminsani ebisinga okwewuunyisa mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa, ekyewaayo okutuuka ku bantu abasinga obwavu n’abasuuliddwa ku bbali mu bantu b’omu mulembe gwa Victoria, nga kibaleetera Enjiri era nga kibalabirira mu bikolwa. Catherine yennyini yali mubuulizi w’enjiri ow’amaanyi mu lujjudde, mu kiseera abakazi okubuulira lwe kyali kitwalibwa ng’ekivve mu Bungereza; yawandiika “Female Ministry” (1859) — okulwanirira okw’obwegendereza, okwesigamiziddwa ku Bayibuli, eddembe ly’abakazi okubuulira — oluvannyuma naye yennyini n’alinnya ku bituuti, ng’asikiriza ebibiina ebinene ennyo era ng’alaba abantu bangi nga bakyuka. Yali maama w’abaana 8, era bonna baaweereza mu Salvation Army. Yafa kookolo mu 1890 ng’alina emyaka 61, era abantu 36,000 baayita ku ssanduuko ye nga bamusiibula.

Okulaba kwe ku Buweereza obw’Obuminsani n’Okwefiiriza

Okulaba kwa Catherine Booth okw’obuminsani kwatandika n’ekibuuzo kye yali tayinza kwekkiriza kuddamu mu ngeri emuwummuza: abantu ekkanisa b’etaali kutuukako baali ludda wa? Bungereza ey’omu mulembe gwa Victoria yalimu amakanisa mangi nnyo — naye abaavu abangi ennyo abaali bakubaganira mu kitundu kya London eky’ebuvanjuba, East End, tebaali mu go. Baali mu mbaala z’omwenge, mu nnyumba z’abaavu ez’okukoleramu, mu makomera, ne mu nguudo. Enjiri bwe yali ddala ya buli muntu, olwo ekkanisa yalina okugenda eri abantu b’etaali kutuukako, mu kifo ky’okulinda bo bajje. Okukakasa kuno tekwali pulojekiti ya bya mbeera za bantu; kwali kukozesa butereevu amazima ga Katonda okufuuka omuntu — Katonda eyakka n’ajja abantu gye baali, kaakano ng’ayita ekkanisa ye ekke egende abazaaye gye bali.

Catherine yategeera okuyitibwa kwe okubuulira ng’okukakasa kwe ku bubwe era ng’ekyetaagisa ekiva mu njigiriza ya Katonda. Ku Ssande emu ku makya mu 1860, bba bwe yalabika ng’atandise okuwugulaza ku kituuti, yakwatibwako n’ayimirira n’asaba okwogera — era okuva olwo teyaddayo nnyuma n’akatono. Obuweereza bwe yabusimba ku bunnabbi olunaku lwa Pentekoote bwe lwatandikawo: “Olulituuka mu nnaku ez’oluvannyuma, bw’ayogera Katonda, ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku balina omubiri bonna. Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe baliwa obunnabbi; n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa, n’abakadde baliroota ebirooto. Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange, ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi; baliwa obunnabbi.” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:17–18). Katonda bwe yali afuse Omwoyo we ku bakazi n’abatuma okuwa obunnabbi, tewali mpisa za bantu ez’omulembe gwa Victoria ezaali ziyinza kusazaamu ekyo Katonda kye yali awadde. Yabuulira n’obuyinza bw’omuntu amanyi nti okutumibwa kwe kwava eri Katonda.

Engeri gye yatuukiriramu abaavu b’omu bibuga yabumbibwa okutegeera nti Enjiri erangirirwa okusookera ku abo abasuuliddwa ku bbali. Yatwala nnyo ekirangiriro Yesu kye yaggulawo nakyo obuweereza bwe obw’olwatu: “Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze. Anfuseeko amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri. Antumye okubuulira abasibe okuteebwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso okuzibulwa amaaso balabe, n’abanyigirizibwa okufuna eddembe, n’okulangirira ekiseera kya Mukama eky’okulagiramu ekisa kye.” (Lukka 4:18–19). Yesu bwe yali afukiddwako amafuta okutuuka ddala ku baavu, ku basibe, ne ku banyigirizibwa, olwo abo abeeyita abagoberezi be baalina obuvunaanyizibwa bwe bumu.

Enkola ya Salvation Army emanyiddwa ennyo ey’okugenda abantu gye bali — okubuulira wabweru mu lujjudde, okukumba mu nguudo z’ebifo by’abaavu nga bakuba ebivuga eby’ebikomo, n’okuteekawo ebifo eby’okugabiramu ssupu okumpi n’enkuŋŋaana z’okubuulira enjiri — kwali kukozesa butereevu kwa Catherine okutumibwa kwa Lukka 4 mu kiseera kye ekyenjawulo mu byafaayo.

Era mu kubuulira kwe enjiri yaleetamu okutegeera okw’obusumba ku ngeri obwetaavu bw’omubiri n’obw’omwoyo gye bikwataganamu. Omuntu afa enjala yali yeetaaga omugaati nga tannaba kuwulira ku Mmere ey’Obulamu. Omukazi ali mu bwamalaaya yali yeetaaga okununulibwa nga tannaba kusobola kuwuliriza kibuulirwa. Kino tekyali kukkiriza bya nsi kusooka, wabula kwali kukakasa okw’eby’eddiini nti ekitiibwa ky’omuntu tekyawulwamu. Mu bbaluwa ey’olubereberye ey’omutume Yokaana yasangamu okusoomoozebwa okutasobola kwewalibwa: “Buli alina ebintu eby’omu nsi n’alaba muganda we nga yeetaaga, naye n’abulwako ky’amuwa, okwagala kwa Katonda, kuyinza kutya okuba mu ye? Abaana abaagalwa, tetusaana kwagala mu bigambo kyokka, wabula twagalanenga ne mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu.” (1 Yokaana 3:17–18). Salvation Army, wansi w’obukulembeze bwa Catherine ne William, yayagala mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu. Abakyuka abaddirira baali bibala by’okwagala okwalagibwa nga tekunnalangirirwa.

Okwefiiriza kwe yennyini kwali kwefiiriza buteefu, linnya lye eddungi, n’obulamu bw’omubiri bwe olw’okuweereza omulimu gw’obuminsani. Yalonda obulamu obw’okukaayanirwa mu lujjudde — omukazi abuulira mu Bungereza ey’omulembe gwa Victoria yasekererwanga, yawakanyizibwanga, era oluusi yakubwanga — so nga yandibadde abeera mu kasirise era mu kitiibwa ng’omukyala w’omusumba. Yalonda ebifo by’abaavu ebijjudde obunaku so nga yandisigadde mu ddiiro lye eddungi.

Era yalonda okufuka emyaka gye egy’enkomerero ne bwe kookolo yali amulya omubiri, ng’ayogerera ku ntebe empanvu bwe yali takyasobola kuyimirira. Yawulira, nga Pawulo bwe yakyogerako, okwagala kwa Kristo nga kumuwaliriza: “Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa. Yafiirira abantu bonna; abalamu balemenga okubeera abalamu ku bwabwe bokka, wabula ku bw’oyo eyabafiirira era n’azuukira” (2 Abakkolinso 5:14–15). Okwagala okwo kwali kumukutte, era tekwamuta n’akatono.

Ekyo kye yalekawo ye Salvation Army ey’ensi yonna — ekola leero mu nsi 132, ng’eweereza abaavu, ng’ebuulira Enjiri, era ng’erwanirira abasuuliddwa ku bbali mu mwoyo gwe gumu ddala abaagitandikawo gwe baagiwa. Ebigambo by’omutume Pawulo eby’okusinda yabitwala ng’ebimukwatako ye yennyini: “Kubanga bwe mbuulira Enjiri sisobola kwenyumiriza, kubanga mpalirizibwa okugibuulira. Era ziba zinsanze bwe sigibuulira.” (1 Abakkolinso 9:16). Yawulira obuzito bw’okusinda okwo. Yabuulira. Era ensi yakyuka olw’ekyo.

Okusaba

Mukama w’abaavu n’abamenyese, tusonyiwe olw’ebbanga lye tukuuma wakati waffe n’abantu Ggwe be wajjira okutuukako ddala. Tuwe okwetegeka kwa Catherine Booth okugenda ekkanisa gy’etali — okusala ebisenge eby’enjawukana mu bantu bye twazimba, n’okubuulira abo be twasuula. Bwe twagala mu bigambo byokka, tuyigirize okwagala mu bikolwa ne mu mazima. Era bw’Otuyita okuwa eddoboozi lyaffe abo abatalina ddoboozi, tuwe obuvumu okuyimirira n’okwogera. Amiina.

Kino tekyali kukkiriza bya nsi kusooka, wabula kwali kukakasa okw’eby’eddiini nti ekitiibwa ky’omuntu tekyawulwamu. Mu bbaluwa ey’olubereberye ey’omutume Yokaana yasangamu okusoomoozebwa okutasobola kwewalibwa: “Buli alina ebintu eby’omu nsi n’alaba muganda we nga yeetaaga, naye n’abulwako ky’amuwa, okwagala kwa Katonda, kuyinza kutya okuba mu ye? Abaana abaagalwa, tetusaana kwagala mu bigambo kyokka, wabula twagalanenga ne mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu.” (1 Yokaana 3:17–18). Salvation Army, wansi w’obukulembeze bwa Catherine ne William, yayagala mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu. Abakyuka abaddirira baali bibala by’okwagala okwalagibwa nga tekunnalangirirwa. Bwe twagala mu bigambo byokka, tuyigirize okwagala mu bikolwa ne mu mazima. Era bw’Otuyita okuwa eddoboozi lyaffe abo abatalina ddoboozi, tuwe obuvumu okuyimirira n’okwogera. Amiina.

fields.title: D.L. Moody — Omutunzi w’Engatto Eyanyeenya Amawanga
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Dwight Lyman Moody yazaalibwa nga 5 Febwali 1837, mu Northfield, Massachusetts, ng’ye mwana ow’omukaaga ku baana mwenda mu maka amaavu, era kitaawe yafa Dwight ng’alina emyaka ena. Ku myaka kkumi na musanvu yagenda e Boston okukola mu dduuka ly’engatto erya kojja we; ku myaka kkumi na munaana yakyuka n’alokoka mu dduuka eryo lyennyini, omusomesa w’Essomero ly’Olwa Sabbiiti ayitibwa Edward Kimball bwe yajja n’amwogerako ku Yesu, ekyo kyokka. Oluvannyuma yasenga e Chicago, gye yafuukira omukozi wa YMCA ow’amaanyi ennyo era omutegesi w’Amasomero g’Olwa Sabbiiti, nga tannaba kwewaayo ddala ku kubuulira njiri. Teyasoma by’eddiini mu ttendekero, teyayawulibwa ng’omusumba, era teyalina kitongole kimuwagira — yalina kyokka okwegomba okw’amaanyi nti buli muntu gw’asisinkana amanye Yesu Kristo. Enkuŋŋaana ze ez’okubuulira enjiri mu Bungereza mu 1873–1875 zaakuŋŋaanyanga abantu abatuuka ku mitwalo esatu buli kiro, era ne zireeta okuzuukuka okw’omwoyo okwawandiikibwa mu byafaayo, okwakankanya eggwanga lyonna.

Yatandikawo Northfield Seminary, Mount Hermon School, Moody Bible Institute, ne Moody Church mu Chicago. Yafa mu 1899 ng’alina emyaka nkaaga mu ebiri, ng’amaze okubuulira ye kennyini abantu abalowoozebwa okuweza obukadde kikumi mu bulamu bwe bwonna obw’obuweereza.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buweereza obw’Obuminsani n’obw’Okwewaayo

Okwolesebwa kwa Moody ku kubuulira enjiri kwazimbibwa ku musingi ogusingayo obwangu: yakkirizanga ddala nti buli muntu gwe yasisinkananga yali mwoyo Kristo gwe yafiirira, era nga yeetaaga okukimanya, era teyasobolanga kumala kiseera kiwanvu na muntu nga okukkiriza okwo tekweyolese. Okubuulira kwe enjiri tekwali kwolesa kwa kikugu, wabula kwali kujjula kwa kwagala kwe yalina eri abantu n’okulumirirwa kwe yalina ku nkomerero yaabwe ey’emirembe gyonna. Yannyonnyola enkola ye mu bigambo bye ebigolokofu nga bulijjo: “Okubuulira okutanyiiza muntu yenna kubuulira kunafu; tekulina kye kwogedde.” Teyafaayo ku ddiini etanyiiza muntu. Yafaayo ku myoyo gy’abantu.

Amaanyi g’enzikiriza agaali emabega w’okubuulira kwa Moody gaali okutegeera kwe okw’obuziba ku kwagala kwa Katonda — naddala nga bwe kwolesebwa mu Njiri ya Yokaana, gye yabuuliranga okusinga ekitabo ekirala kyonna mu Byawandiikibwa. Yagaana okwanjula enjiri okusinga ng’enkola y’enjigiriza ez’okukkiriza oba ng’amateeka ag’okugoberera; yagyanjulanga ng’okwagala okulina okusembezebwa.

Enkuŋŋaana ze ezaasinga obukulu yazizimbanga ku kyawandiikibwa kimu: “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo” (Yokaana 3:16). Yayogera ku lunyiriri olwo nti: “Ntambudde ensi yonna eyogera Olungereza n’ekyawandiikibwa kino kimu kyokka. Nzikiriza nti kye kyawandiikibwa ekisinga amaanyi mu Bayibuli yonna.” Yakibuulira mu London eri abantu emitwalo esatu. Yakibuulira abakozi b’eggaali y’omukka mu Chicago. Yakibuulira mu makomera, mu bitundu by’abaavu, mu yunivasite, ne mu bizimbe by’emizannyo. Tekyaggwaamu maanyi.

Okutegeera kwa Moody ku mulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kubuulira enjiri kwali kukulu nnyo ng’ekitundu ekirala kyonna eky’obuweereza bwe. Yali akyusiddwa ekyo kye yayita “okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu” mu 1871 — ekintu kye yalaga nti kye kyakyusa ennyo amaanyi g’okubuulira kwe okuva olwo. Yeekengeranga nnyo okubuulira enjiri kwonna okwesigama ku bwogezi bw’abantu, ku kukozesa enneewulira z’abantu mu bukodyo, oba ku nteekateeka z’ebibiina, mu kifo ky’omulimu gw’Omwoyo ow’obuyinza bwonna. Yanywerera ku kisuubizo kya Yesu yennyini: “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Amaanyi tegaali ga Moody. Amaanyi gaali ga Mwoyo. Moody yali yeeteeseteese bweteeseteese okukozesebwa — era ekyo, mu nteekateeka ya Katonda, kyazuulibwa nti kimala ddala.

Enjigiriza ye nti omukkiriza owa bulijjo naye mubuulizi w’enjiri yali emu ku bintu bye yawaayo ebyasinga okugasa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Yagaana okukkiriza endowooza y’omu kiseera kye, eyali tekyogerwa lwatu, nti omulimu gwa ddiini gwa basumba bokka — endowooza nti okuwangula emyoyo gwali mulimu gwa basumba abaayawulibwa, ate ng’abakkiriza abalala balina kujja mu kkanisa, kuwaayo ssente, era oluusi okuyita omuntu ajje mu kkanisa. Yatendeka abantu nkumi na nkumi okubuulira enjiri omuntu ku muntu, yazimba ebibiina ebyategekanga Abakristaayo aba bulijjo okugabana okukkiriza kwabwe, era yakalambira nti buli muntu eyakyuka yali asobola okufuuka naye omubuulizi w’enjiri. Yali anywezezza okwolesebwa kwa Pawulo: “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2). Buli muntu eyatuukibwako yali naye asobola okutuuka ku balala. Olujegere lwali lwa kugenda mu maaso.

Okugaba kwa Moody okw’okwewaayo tekwamanyibwa nnyo ng’okubuulira kwe, naye kwali kwa kitalo kyenkanyi. Yagabanga ssente nnyingi okusinga ze yeekuumiranga, ng’agaana buli kiseera okwegaggawaza n’ebiva mu buweereza. Yatandikawo amasomero n’ettendekero kubanga yategeera nti okubuulira enjiri awatali kusomesa na kutendeka kuzaala Abakristaayo abatanywera.

Yateeka ebyobugagga bye mu kuzimba ebyetaagisa enjiri olw’okuba yakkiriza nti omulimu gw’obwakabaka gwali gwa mangu nnyo nga gwetaaga si kubuulira kwe kwokka, wabula n’obugagga bwe. Yali atwala nga kikulu nnyo ekyo kye yabuuliranga: mujjukire nti, “Asiga ekitono alikungula kitono, naye asiga ekinene alikungula kinene” (2 Abakkolinso 9:6). Yasiga kinene. Amakungula ge yasiga gakyakungulwa n’okutuusa leero.

Yafa wayise wiiki ntono oluvannyuma lw’olukuŋŋaana lwe olw’okubuulira olwasembayo, ng’amaze okubuulira obubaka bwe obwasembayo mu Kansas City ng’alwadde nnyo. Bwe yabuulirwa nti agenda kufa, yaddamu n’emirembe: “Ensi eggwaawo, Eggulu ligguka mu maaso gange.” Teyatya. Yali awangadde ng’atambulira mu kigambo kya Pawulo, era kaakano yali ayingira mu kutuukirizibwa kwakyo: “Nze mba mulamu lwa Kristo era ne bwe nfa mba ngobolodde” (Abafiripi 1:21). Amagoba ge gaali gatuuse. Yali amaze okukola omutunzi w’engatto eyava e Northfield kye yatumibwa okukola.

Essaala

Mukama, otujjukize nti toyita abo abeetegese, wabula otegeka abo b’oyise, era nti ekisinga amaanyi mu kubuulira enjiri si bwogezi bwaffe, wabula kwagala kwa Kristo n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo Wo. Tuwe okulumirirwa okutazikira Moody kwe yalina eri abantu abatwetoolodde abatannakumanya Ggwe. Tuyigirize okusiga kinene — ebigambo byaffe, ebiseera byaffe, n’ebintu byaffe — era okwesiga nti Ggwe oliwa amakungula.

Amiina.

fields.title: Pandita Ramabai — Omuyivu Eyawaayo Byonna ku lw’Abawala ba Buyindi
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Pandita Ramabai Dongre Medhavi yazaalibwa nga April 23, 1858, mu bibira by’ensozi za Western Ghats e Buyindi. Yali muwala w’omuyivu Omuhindu ow’ekika kya Brahmin eyanywerera ku nzikiriza ye, eyasalawo ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo: okuyigiriza mukyala we ne bawala be Olusanskiriti, ng’ajeemera empisa z’ebika ezaali zimaze ebyasa n’ebyasa. Amaka gaabwe gaafuuka balamazi abatabeera wamu, nga bakyalira buli kiggwa ekinene eky’Abahindu mu Buyindi mu lugendo lw’okunoonya eby’omwoyo. Bazadde be ne mwannyina baafa enjala mu 1874–1877, era Pandita — ng’asigadde yekka, nga mwavu lunkupe, era ng’essuubi limuweddemu ddala — n’agenda e Calcutta, abayivu b’eyo gye beewuunyiza ennyo obukugu bwe mu Lusanskiriti ne bamuwa ebitiibwa “Pandita” (Omuyivu) ne “Sarasvati” — ebitiibwa ebyali bitaweebwangako mukazi yenna. Yagenda e Bungereza, n’asisinkana Obukristaayo, n’abatizibwa mu 1883. Yaddayo e Buyindi, n’atandika Mukti Mission (“Obulokozi”) mu Pune ku lwa bannamwandu abaali mu bwavu obw’amaanyi n’abawala bamulekwa, n’avvuunula Bayibuli yonna okuva mu Lwebbulaniya ne mu Luyonaani okugiteeka mu Lumarathi — omulimu ogwamala emyaka gye kkumi n’esatu egy’enkomerero — era n’akyaza Okuzuukuka kwa Mukti okwa 1905–1906, okwasooka okwa Azusa Street era ne kukoleeza omuliro gw’okuzuukuka mu Buyindi yonna. Yafa mu 1922 ng’aweza emyaka nkaaga mu ssatu, olunaku lumu oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza okuvvuunula Bayibuli ye.

Okwolesebwa kwe ku Buweereza obw’Obuminsani n’obw’Okwewaayo

Amiina.

fields.title: C.T. Studd — Omuzannyi wa Kiriketi ow’Erinnya Eyagaba Obugagga Bwe Bwonna
fields.body_html:
Ye Yali Ani

Charles Thomas Studd yazaalibwa nga 2 Ddesemba, 1860, e Spratton, mu Northamptonshire, Bungereza. Kitaawe yali musajja mugagga eyali alimye indigo n’awummula, eyakyuka mu ngeri ey’amaanyi mu lukuŋŋaana lwa D.L. Moody, era okukyuka kwe ne kukyusa amaka ga Studd gonna. C.T. yafuuka omu ku bazannyi ba kiriketi abaali basinga okutenderezebwa mu Bungereza — yali mu ttiimu ya Cambridge XI, era oluvannyuma mu ttiimu ya Bungereza ey’emipiira gya Test — naye ku myaka abiri mu gumu, obulwadde bwa muganda we George obwali bubulako katono okumutta ne bumukankanya, n’atandika okutwala okukkiriza kwe nga kikulu ddala. Yali omu ku “Cambridge Seven,” ekibinja ky’abazannyi musanvu okuva e Cambridge abaalekulira mu lwatu emizannyo gyabwe mu 1885 ne basaabala okugenda e China wansi wa China Inland Mission eya Hudson Taylor, ne bakubiriza omulembe gwonna ogw’abavubuka okulowooza ku kuweereza ng’abaminsani. Yagaba obusika bwe bwonna — paawundi nga emitwalo ebiri mu kenda — eri emirimu egy’enjawulo egy’Ekikristaayo, n’atasigaza kantu na kamu ku lulwe. Oluvannyuma yaweereza mu Buyindi, n’addayo e Bungereza, era ku myaka ataano n’atandikawo Heart of Africa Mission (kati eyitibwa WEC International), n’agenda yennyini mu masekkati g’Afirika, gye yaweereza okutuusa lwe yafiira mu Kongo ya Bubirigi mu 1931 ng’alina emyaka nsanvu.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buweereza bw’Obuminsani n’Okwefiiriza

Enjigiriza ya C.T. Studd ku buminsani obw’okwefiiriza yandisobodde okufunzibwa mu sentensi ye esinga okumanyika gye yali awandiise, gye yawandiika ku mabega g’ebbaasa mu kiseera kye eky’obuminsani: “Abamu baagala okubeera awali eddoboozi ly’ekide ky’ekkanisa oba ery’ekiggwa; nze njagala okuddukanya edduuka ery’okutaasa abantu, yaadi emu okuva ku ggeyeena.” Kino tekyali kwewaana, wabula nzikiriza gye yali alowoozezzaako n’obwegendereza: obanga enjiri ya mazima — obanga ggeyeena weeri ddala era Kristo yafa okuziyiza abantu okugendayo — kale okutegeka obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’eddembe nga bwetooloolera ku kukula kw’omuntu mu by’omwoyo n’okulabirira ekibiina ky’ekkanisa kyokka, kyali kusobya kunene nnyo okw’akabi ak’entiisa. Obwetaavu obw’amangu obw’omulimu gw’obuminsani bwafuula buli kintu ekirala ekitali kikulu nnyo okulabika ng’ekitono.

Okugaba obusika bwe bwonna kye kyali ekirango kya Studd ekisinga obuzito ku by’obuminsani, era yakikola mu bugenderevu, mu lwatu, era n’essanyu. Yali awulidde emirundi mingi olugero lw’omufuzi omuvubuka omugagga; ye teyalina kigendererwa kwawukana na Yesu ng’anakuwadde. Yesu yali agambye nti: “Obanga oyagala okuba omutuukirivu genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu, kale oliba n’obugagga mu ggulu, olyoke ojje ongoberere.” (Matayo 19:21). Studd yatwala ebigambo bino ng’ebyogeddwa gy’ali ye kennyini. Yatunda, n’agaba, n’agoberera. Yagabanya obusika bwe mu nkuŋŋaana za Moody, Salvation Army, amaka g’abaana bamulekwa aga George Müller, n’emirimu emirala egiwerako, n’asaabala okugenda e China nga talina kintu kyonna kimukuuma mu by’ensimbi. Oluvannyuma yategeeza nti essanyu ly’okugaba okwo lyali lisinga omuwendo ensimbi ze yali akuumye mu myaka egyasooka nga tannazigaba.

Enjigiriza ye ku mpeke y’eŋŋaano kye kyali ekifaananyi ekyafuga obuweereza bwe bwonna obw’obuminsani. Yali awulidde Yokaana 12:24 emirundi mingi nnyo ne kiba nti olunyiriri olwo terwali lwa kumanyiddwa bumanyibwa, wabula lwafuuka okuyitibwa kwe ye kennyini: “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi” (Yokaana 12:24). Studd yatwala obulamu bwe — eddembe lye, obugagga bwe, amaanyi g’omubiri gwe, n’erinnya lye — nga y’empeke y’eŋŋaano. Yali mwetegefu okugwa mu ttaka, okwefiirwa yekka, mu ngeri yonna obuminsani gye bwali bwetaaga, ng’akkiriza nti okufa kw’okwenoonyeza ebibye kwe kwokka okuyinza okuba ettaka eryesigika ery’ebibala ebya nnamaddala eby’obwakabaka. Okwagala kwe okugenda mu Afirika ng’alina emyaka ataano, ng’omubiri gwe munafu, nga tewali kitongole kimuwagira, kwe kwali okwolesa okusinga obweyoleefu okw’enjigiriza eno kwe yali awadde.

Studd era yalina enjigiriza eyaka ng’omuliro nti abantu abatannatuukibwako njiri be basookerwako mu buminsani. Teyafaayo ku kunyweza makanisa agaali gasangibwawo dda mu bifo enjiri gye yali etuuse. Yali amaliddwa ekizikiza ky’ebifo ebyali bitalina kitangaala n’akatono. Yalina ekiruubirirwa kye kimu ne Pawulo: “Nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo, nneme okuzimba ku musingi gw’omuntu omulala, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, ‘Abo abatategeezebwanga bimufaako baliraba, n’abo abatawulirangako balitegeera’” (Abaruumi 15:20–21). Munda mu Afirika omutaabuulirwanga njiri yamusikiriza nga empiso ya kampasi bw’esikirizibwa obukiikakkono. Yagoberera okusika okwo okutuusa lwe yafa, era WEC International — kati ekola mu nsi ezisoba mu nkaaga — kye kibala ky’ensigo gye yasiga.

Emyaka gye egy’oluvannyuma gyaleetamu enkaayana. Obulamu bwe obw’okwerumya n’ebyo bye yasuubiranga ennyo okuva mu bakozi banne byaleeta obutakkaanya bungi mu kibiina kye yennyini eky’obuminsani. Teyali muntu mwangu. Naye n’abo abaamunenyanga baakkiriza nti okwefiiriza kwe yasabanga abalala kwali kitundu kitono nnyo ku ekyo kye yeesabanga ye yennyini. Ensonga y’eddembe lye yali yagimalawo dda nnyo. Yali awaddeyo buli kimu eri obuminsani — obuvubuka, obugagga, amaanyi g’omubiri, okubeera kumpi n’ab’omu maka ge, n’okwewummuza kw’omubiri — era teyejjusa. Yanywerera ku kubalirira kwa Pawulo: “Okubonaabona kwe tubonaabona kaakano kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa.” (Abaruumi 8:18).

Yali abaze ebibye ye kennyini n’atuuka ku kino kye kimu. Kyonna okuba omuminsani kye kyamufiiriza tekyali kya kugeraageranya na mugaso gwakwo.

Essaala

Mukama eyatuwaayo buli kimu ku lwaffe, tununule okuva mu bufuge bw’okwekwata ebintu n’okweraliikirira okubifiirwa. Bwe twekwata ku bugagga, ku ddembe, ne ku bukuumi ng’ebyo bye bitulokola, ggulawo emikono gyaffe. Tuwe essanyu lya Studd ery’okwewaayo okutalina kkomo — eddembe ly’omuntu eyamalirira nti empeke y’eŋŋaano erina okugwa mu ttaka.

Era bw’otuyita okuddukanya edduuka ery’okutaasa abantu okumpi ne ggeyeena, tuwe obuvumu okuggulawo oluggi. Amiina.

Yali omu ku “Cambridge Seven,” ekibinja ky’abazannyi musanvu okuva e Cambridge abaalekulira mu lwatu emizannyo gyabwe mu 1885 ne basaabala okugenda e China wansi wa China Inland Mission eya Hudson Taylor, ne bakubiriza omulembe gwonna ogw’abavubuka okulowooza ku kuweereza ng’abaminsani. Yagaba obusika bwe bwonna — paawundi nga emitwalo ebiri mu kenda — eri emirimu egy’enjawulo egy’Ekikristaayo, n’atasigaza kantu na kamu ku lulwe. Oluvannyuma yaweereza mu Buyindi, n’addayo e Bungereza, era ku myaka ataano n’atandikawo Heart of Africa Mission (kati eyitibwa WEC International), n’agenda yennyini mu masekkati g’Afirika, gye yaweereza okutuusa lwe yafiira mu Kongo ya Bubirigi mu 1931 ng’alina emyaka nsanvu. Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buweereza bw’Obuminsani n’Okwefiiriza Enjigiriza ya C.T. Studd ku buminsani obw’okwefiiriza yandisobodde okufunzibwa mu sentensi ye esinga okumanyika gye yali awandiise, gye yawandiika ku mabega g’ebbaasa mu kiseera kye eky’obuminsani: “Abamu baagala okubeera awali eddoboozi ly’ekide ky’ekkanisa oba ery’ekiggwa; nze njagala okuddukanya edduuka ery’okutaasa abantu, yaadi emu okuva ku ggeyeena.” Kino tekyali kwewaana, wabula nzikiriza gye yali alowoozezzaako n’obwegendereza: obanga enjiri ya mazima — obanga ggeyeena weeri ddala era Kristo yafa okuziyiza abantu okugendayo — kale okutegeka obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’eddembe nga bwetooloolera ku kukula kw’omuntu mu by’omwoyo n’okulabirira ekibiina ky’ekkanisa kyokka, kyali kusobya kunene nnyo okw’akabi ak’entiisa. Obwetaavu obw’amangu obw’omulimu gw’obuminsani bwafuula buli kintu ekirala ekitali kikulu nnyo okulabika ng’ekitono. Okugaba obusika bwe bwonna kye kyali ekirango kya Studd ekisinga obuzito ku by’obuminsani, era yakikola mu bugenderevu, mu lwatu, era n’essanyu. Yali awulidde emirundi mingi olugero lw’omufuzi omuvubuka omugagga; ye teyalina kigendererwa kwawukana na Yesu ng’anakuwadde. Yesu yali agambye nti: “Obanga oyagala okuba omutuukirivu genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu, kale oliba n’obugagga mu ggulu, olyoke ojje ongoberere.” (Matayo 19:21). Studd yatwala ebigambo bino ng’ebyogeddwa gy’ali ye kennyini. Yatunda, n’agaba, n’agoberera. Yagabanya obusika bwe mu nkuŋŋaana za Moody, Salvation Army, amaka g’abaana bamulekwa aga George Müller, n’emirimu emirala egiwerako, n’asaabala okugenda e China nga talina kintu kyonna kimukuuma mu by’ensimbi. Oluvannyuma yategeeza nti essanyu ly’okugaba okwo lyali lisinga omuwendo ensimbi ze yali akuumye mu myaka egyasooka nga tannazigaba. Enjigiriza ye ku mpeke y’eŋŋaano kye kyali ekifaananyi ekyafuga obuweereza bwe bwonna obw’obuminsani. Yali awulidde Yokaana 12:24 emirundi mingi nnyo ne kiba nti olunyiriri olwo terwali lwa kumanyiddwa bumanyibwa, wabula lwafuuka okuyitibwa kwe ye kennyini: “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi” (Yokaana 12:24). Studd yatwala obulamu bwe — eddembe lye, obugagga bwe, amaanyi g’omubiri gwe, n’erinnya lye — nga y’empeke y’eŋŋaano. Yali mwetegefu okugwa mu ttaka, okwefiirwa yekka, mu ngeri yonna obuminsani gye bwali bwetaaga, ng’akkiriza nti okufa kw’okwenoonyeza ebibye kwe kwokka okuyinza okuba ettaka eryesigika ery’ebibala ebya nnamaddala eby’obwakabaka. Okwagala kwe okugenda mu Afirika ng’alina emyaka ataano, ng’omubiri gwe munafu, nga tewali kitongole kimuwagira, kwe kwali okwolesa okusinga obweyoleefu okw’enjigiriza eno kwe yali awadde. Studd era yalina enjigiriza eyaka ng’omuliro nti abantu abatannatuukibwako njiri be basookerwako mu buminsani. Teyafaayo ku kunyweza makanisa agaali gasangibwawo dda mu bifo enjiri gye yali etuuse. Yali amaliddwa ekizikiza ky’ebifo ebyali bitalina kitangaala n’akatono. Yalina ekiruubirirwa kye kimu ne Pawulo: “Nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo, nneme okuzimba ku musingi gw’omuntu omulala, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, ‘Abo abatategeezebwanga bimufaako baliraba, n’abo abatawulirangako balitegeera’” (Abaruumi 15:20–21). Munda mu Afirika omutaabuulirwanga njiri yamusikiriza nga empiso ya kampasi bw’esikirizibwa obukiikakkono. Yagoberera okusika okwo okutuusa lwe yafa, era WEC International — kati ekola mu nsi ezisoba mu nkaaga — kye kibala ky’ensigo gye yasiga. Emyaka gye egy’oluvannyuma gyaleetamu enkaayana. Obulamu bwe obw’okwerumya n’ebyo bye yasuubiranga ennyo okuva mu bakozi banne byaleeta obutakkaanya bungi mu kibiina kye yennyini eky’obuminsani. Teyali muntu mwangu. Naye n’abo abaamunenyanga baakkiriza nti okwefiiriza kwe yasabanga abalala kwali kitundu kitono nnyo ku ekyo kye yeesabanga ye yennyini. Ensonga y’eddembe lye yali yagimalawo dda nnyo. Yali awaddeyo buli kimu eri obuminsani — obuvubuka, obugagga, amaanyi g’omubiri, okubeera kumpi n’ab’omu maka ge, n’okwewummuza kw’omubiri — era teyejjusa. Yanywerera ku kubalirira kwa Pawulo: “Okubonaabona kwe tubonaabona kaakano kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa.” (Abaruumi 8:18). Yali abaze ebibye ye kennyini n’atuuka ku kino kye kimu. Kyonna okuba omuminsani kye kyamufiiriza tekyali kya kugeraageranya na mugaso gwakwo. Essaala Mukama eyatuwaayo buli kimu ku lwaffe, tununule okuva mu bufuge bw’okwekwata ebintu n’okweraliikirira okubifiirwa. Bwe twekwata ku bugagga, ku ddembe, ne ku bukuumi ng’ebyo bye bitulokola, ggulawo emikono gyaffe. Tuwe essanyu lya Studd ery’okwewaayo okutalina kkomo — eddembe ly’omuntu eyamalirira nti empeke y’eŋŋaano erina okugwa mu ttaka. Era bw’otuyita okuddukanya edduuka ery’okutaasa abantu okumpi ne ggeyeena, tuwe obuvumu okuggulawo oluggi. Amiina.

fields.title: John Stott — Omusomesa wa Bayibuli Eyaweereza Ensi Yonna
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

John Robert Walmsley Stott yazaalibwa nga April 27, 1921, mu London, nga mutabani w’omusawo eyali amanyiddwa ennyo, era n’asomera mu Rugby School ne mu Trinity College, Cambridge. Yakyuka ku myaka kkumi na musanvu bwe yawulira okwogera kw’Omwawule E.J.H. Nash, era okuva mu kaseera ako obulamu bwe ne bufuna ekkubo eritakyuka. Yatuuzibwa ng’omuyambi w’omusumba ku All Souls Church, Langham Place, London, mu 1945, era n’aweereza ekkanisa eyo mu bifo eby’enjawulo okumala emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga egyaddirira — okusooka ng’omuyambi w’omusumba, oluvannyuma ng’omusumba omukulu, n’oluvannyuma ng’omusumba omukulu eyawummula. Okunnyonnyola kwe okwa Bayibuli, ebitabo bye, n’obuweereza bwe mu nsi yonna byamufuula omusomesa wa Bayibuli ow’enjiri asinga okuba n’obuyinza mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri: magazini Time yamubala mu bantu kikumi abaasinga okuba n’obuyinza mu nsi mu 2005. Yategeka Olukuŋŋaana olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubunyisa Enjiri olwa 1974 e Lausanne, n’awandiika Endagaano ya Lausanne, era okuyita mu Langham Partnership n’ateeka ensimbi ze yafunanga mu bitabo bye mu kuwa ekkanisa mu nsi ezikyakula obuyivu bwa Bayibuli obw’enjiri n’ebitabo. Teyawasa, yabeeranga mu bulamu obwangu ennyo obwayogerwangako buli wamu, yagabanga ensimbi ze ez’ebitabo, era yafa mu 2011 ng’alina emyaka kyenda, ng’amaze emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga ng’aweereza ekkanisa ya Kristo awatali kuyimirira.

Okwolesebwa kwe ku Buweereza obw’Obuminsani n’obw’Okwefiiriza

Ekyo John Stott kye yali akkiriza ennyo kyali nti omulimu gw’ekkanisa ogw’obuminsani mu nsi yonna tegwawukana na kuyigiriza Bayibuli okw’obwesigwa, era nti okuyigiriza Bayibuli okw’obwesigwa tekwawukana na mulimu gw’ekkanisa ogw’obuminsani mu nsi yonna. Bino tebyali mirimu ebiri egy’enjawulo egyetaaga okutebenkezebwa n’obwegendereza; byali kuyitibwa kumu okugattiddwa awamu. Ekkanisa eteyabuulira njiri yonna eri ensi yonna yali eremererwa Omusomesa waayo; ekkanisa eteyasimba kubuulira kwayo ku magezi gonna Katonda ge yabikkula mu Byawandiikibwa yali tebuulira njiri yonna. Stott yawaayo obulamu bwe eri byombi omulundi gumu, era Langham Partnership — gye yatandikawo n’agiwa ensimbi ze ez’ebitabo — kye kyali ekyakulabirako ekisinga okulabika eky’okugatta kuno.

Stott yayita empisa y’okulangirira Kristo “okuwuliriza emirundi ebiri”: okussaayo omwoyo ennyo ku Kigambo kya Katonda ne ku nsi mwe kirangirirwa, kubanga tewali na kimu ku byo ekiyinza okukwatibwako mu ngeri ey’obuvunaanyizibwa nga ekirala kirekeddwa. Omubuulizi eyamanya Bayibuli naye nga tamanyi nsi yandibuulidde obubaka obutakwatagana na bantu abamuwuliriza.

Omuminsani eyamanya ensi naye nga tamanyi Bayibuli teyandibadde na kintu kya njawulo kye yandigigambye.

Obuvunaanyizibwa buno obw’emirundi ebiri yabusimba ku bubaka bwa Pawulo obumanyiddwa ennyo bwe yabuulira ku Aleyopaago mu Asene — Pawulo mwe yalagira nga bw’amanyi obulungi ennyo ebitontome n’amagezi g’Abayonaani nga tannalangirira Kristo nga ye Katonda Atamanyiddwa: “kubanga bwe mbadde ntambulatambula ne ndaba ebyoto bya ssaddaaka bingi, ne ku kimu nga kuliko ebigambo bino nti: Kya Katonda Atamanyiddwa. Mubadde mumusinza nga temumumanyi, nange kaakano njagala mbamutegeeze” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 17:23). Pawulo yali awulirizza ensi n’obwegendereza ekimala okuzuula w’asinziira okubatuukako. Stott yakkiriza nti ababuulizi ba buli mulembe bayitibwa okuwuliriza mu ngeri y’emu ey’obwegendereza n’ekitiibwa.

Okwolesebwa kwe okw’obuminsani okuzingiramu okubunyisa enjiri awamu n’obuvunaanyizibwa eri embeera z’abantu kye kimu ku birungi bye yaleeta ebisinga obukulu era ebyakubaganyizibwako ennyo empaka. Mu Lausanne 1974, yawolereza n’amaanyi era n’obuwanguzi nti Endagaano ya Lausanne erina okuzingiramu okuyamba abantu mu mbeera zaabwe awamu n’okubunyisa enjiri ng’ekitundu ku buvunaanyizibwa bw’ekkanisa obw’obuminsani — si ng’ekisikira okulangirira, wabula ng’omubeezi gwe kwetaaga. Kino yakisimba ku bunene bw’Ekiragiro Ekikulu kyennyini: “Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe” (Matayo 28:20). Byonna Yesu bye yalagira byazingiramu ebiragiro ebikwata ku bwenkanya, ku kusaasira, ne ku kwagala muliraanwa. Obuminsani obulangirira okusonyiyibwa ebibi nga bwe bulagajjalira obutali bwenkanya obuli mu nteekateeka z’ensi, Stott bwe yagamba, bubuulira kitundu kimu kyokka eky’enjiri.

Obunyiikivu bwe eri ekkanisa y’omu nsi ez’Obukiikaddyo bw’ensi bwalabikira mu myaka mingi egy’obuweereza bw’okuyigiriza, ne mu nsimbi Langham Partnership ze yateeka mu buyivu bwa Bayibuli obw’abantu b’omu nsi ezo bennyini. Yategeera nti okukula kw’ekkanisa okusinga obunene mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri kwali tekubeera mu Bulaaya ne mu Amerika ey’Obukiikakkono, wabula mu Afirika, mu Asiya, ne mu Latin Amerika — era nti obwetaavu obw’obuminsani obusinga okwanguyirira mu kkanisa ezo tebwali bwa baminsani bangi okuva mu Bugwanjuba, wabula bwa basumba n’abayivu ab’omu kitundu abategekeddwa obulungi. Yali atwala nnyo okwolesebwa kwa Pawulo okutuuka ku mirembe egy’enjawulo: “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2). Ye yali Pawulo; abayivu ba Langham be baali Timoseewo be, n’abayizi baabwe be baali omulembe ogwaddako.

Obulamu bwa Stott obwangu bwali bujulizi bwa buminsani ku bwabwo. Yagaana okukuzibwa mu bifo eby’obukulu mu kkanisa n’ekitiibwa ekibigoberera. Yabeeranga mu nnyumba entono, ng’ayambala engoye ezaabulijjo, nga kumpi talina ky’alina, era ng’agaba ensimbi z’ebitabo bye — ebyali bivaamu ensimbi nnyingi okutuuka mu myaka gya 1970. Ebyo bye yabuuliranga ku butakwatagana wakati w’okukuŋŋaanya ebintu n’obuminsani obw’omutima ogumu yali abiyingizza mu bulamu bwe. Yali atwala nnyo ekiragiro Yesu kye yawa: “Temweterekeranga byabugagga wano ku nsi kwe biyinza okwonoonebwa ennyenje n’obutalagge, n’ababbi kwe bayinza okubibbira. Naye mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe mu ggulu” (Matayo 6:19–20). Obugagga bwe bwali buterekeddwa walala. Ensimbi ze ez’ebitabo zaazimba amaterekero g’ebitabo, zaatendeka abayivu, era zaateeka Bayibuli mu mikono gy’abasumba mu nnimi ze yali tayogera — kye kyali ekiteekebwamu ekisinga okuwangaala era ekisinga okuba eky’obuminsani kye yali asobola okukola.

Okuyigiriza kwe okwasembayo mu lujjudde kwali kukuutira mulembe omuggya okuba abantu b’Ekigambo mu nsi eyali efiiriddwa obwesige mu kyo. Yali amaze emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga ng’alaga obulamu obuzimbiddwa ku Byawandiikibwa bwe bufaanana. Obubaka bwe obwasembayo bwaddamu okukuutira kwa Pawulo okwasembayo: “Nkukuutirira mu maaso ga Katonda ne Kristo Yesu, anaatera okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango, era n’olw’okujja kwe, n’olw’obwakabaka bwe, buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu” (2 Timoseewo 4:1–2). Yali akibuulidde okumala emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga. Okubuulira okwo yakukwasa omulembe oguddako n’obwesige bwe bumu Pawulo bwe yalina bwe yakukwasa Timoseewo.

Essaala

Mukama w’Ekigambo n’ensi, tuwe okuwuliriza kwa Stott okw’emirundi ebiri okw’empisa ennungi — okukuwulira ng’oyogera mu Byawandiikibwa, n’okuwulira ensi mw’otuyita okwogera. Bwe tukuuma okukkiriza kwaffe nga kwa kyama ne Bayibuli yaffe nga ya kutubudaabuda ffekka, otusiikuule tutandike okulangirira. Tuyigirize okugaba nga Stott bwe yagaba — si ku bitufikkiddeko wabula okuva mu makkati g’ebyo bye tulina — n’okutereka obugagga bwaffe ennyenje gye zitasobola kubutuuka. Amiina.

Yali atwala nnyo okwolesebwa kwa Pawulo okutuuka ku mirembe egy’enjawulo: “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2). Ye yali Pawulo; abayivu ba Langham be baali Timoseewo be, n’abayizi baabwe be baali omulembe ogwaddako. Obulamu bwa Stott obwangu bwali bujulizi bwa buminsani ku bwabwo. Yagaana okukuzibwa mu bifo eby’obukulu mu kkanisa n’ekitiibwa ekibigoberera. Yabeeranga mu nnyumba entono, ng’ayambala engoye ezaabulijjo, nga kumpi talina ky’alina, era ng’agaba ensimbi z’ebitabo bye — ebyali bivaamu ensimbi nnyingi okutuuka mu myaka gya 1970. Ebyo bye yabuuliranga ku butakwatagana wakati w’okukuŋŋaanya ebintu n’obuminsani obw’omutima ogumu yali abiyingizza mu bulamu bwe. Yali atwala nnyo ekiragiro Yesu kye yawa: “Temweterekeranga byabugagga wano ku nsi kwe biyinza okwonoonebwa ennyenje n’obutalagge, n’ababbi kwe bayinza okubibbira. Naye mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe mu ggulu” (Matayo 6:19–20). Obugagga bwe bwali buterekeddwa walala. Ensimbi ze ez’ebitabo zaazimba amaterekero g’ebitabo, zaatendeka abayivu, era zaateeka Bayibuli mu mikono gy’abasumba mu nnimi ze yali tayogera — kye kyali ekiteekebwamu ekisinga okuwangaala era ekisinga okuba eky’obuminsani kye yali asobola okukola. Okuyigiriza kwe okwasembayo mu lujjudde kwali kukuutira mulembe omuggya okuba abantu b’Ekigambo mu nsi eyali efiiriddwa obwesige mu kyo. Yali amaze emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga ng’alaga obulamu obuzimbiddwa ku Byawandiikibwa bwe bufaanana. Obubaka bwe obwasembayo bwaddamu okukuutira kwa Pawulo okwasembayo: “Nkukuutirira mu maaso ga Katonda ne Kristo Yesu, anaatera okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango, era n’olw’okujja kwe, n’olw’obwakabaka bwe, buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu” (2 Timoseewo 4:1–2). Yali akibuulidde okumala emyaka nkaaga mu mukaaga. Okubuulira okwo yakukwasa omulembe oguddako n’obwesige bwe bumu Pawulo bwe yalina bwe yakukwasa Timoseewo. Essaala Mukama w’Ekigambo n’ensi, tuwe okuwuliriza kwa Stott okw’emirundi ebiri okw’empisa ennungi — okukuwulira ng’oyogera mu Byawandiikibwa, n’okuwulira ensi mw’otuyita okwogera. Bwe tukuuma okukkiriza kwaffe nga kwa kyama ne Bayibuli yaffe nga ya kutubudaabuda ffekka, otusiikuule tutandike okulangirira. fields.title: Helen Roseveare — Omusawo Eyayita Okubonaabona Enkizo
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Helen Roseveare yazaalibwa nga September 21, 1925, mu Haileybury, Bungereza, mu maka agaali mu mbeera ennungi, era n’akyuka n’afuuka Omukristaayo bwe yali ng’asomera e Cambridge. Yatendekebwa okubeera omusawo, n’asaabala okugenda mu Kongo eyali efugibwa Bubirigi (kaakano eyitibwa Democratic Republic of the Congo) mu 1953 ng’ali wansi wa WEC International. Ebitundu ebisinga obungi eby’emyaka amakumi abiri egyaddirira yabimala mu Kongo, ng’azimba eddwaliro, ng’atendeka abajjanjabi, era ng’atandikawo essomero ly’obusawo mu mbeera enzibu ennyo ddala. Mu 1964, mu kiseera ky’obujeemu bwa Simba obwaddirira Kongo okufuna obwetwaze, yakwatibwa abajaasi abajeemu n’akolebwako ebikolwa eby’obukambwe ebitagambika okumala emyezi egiwerako nga tannaba kununulibwa. Yasalawo — nga bw’annyonnyola mu kitabo ky’obulamu bwe “Give Me This Mountain” — okuddayo mu Kongo ng’amaze okuwona, era n’aweereza eyo okutuusa mu 1973. Emyaka amakumi egyasigalawo mu bulamu bwe yagimala ng’ayogera era ng’awandiika ku nkizo ey’okubonaabona mu kuweereza Kristo, okutuusa lwe yafa mu 2016 ng’alina emyaka kyenda mu gumu.

Endowooza Ye ku Buweereza bw’Obuminsani obw’Okwefiiriza

Ekyo Helen Roseveare kye yasinga okuyamba mu kutegeera okwefiiriza mu buminsani kyali kibuuzo kye yagamba nti Katonda yakimubuuza mu kiro ekyasinga okuba eky’ekizikiza mu buwambe bwe: “Osobola okunneebaza olw’okukwesiga n’okukukwasa ekintu kino ky’oyitamu, ne bwe sirikubuulira lwaki?” Ekibuuzo ekyo kyakyusa endaba ye ku buli kintu. Okubonaabona tekwali kizibu kya ddiini eky’okugonjoola, wadde akabenje ak’obukambwe ak’okunnyonnyola; kwali kikolwa kya Katonda eky’okwesiga — okukwasa omuntu omu ekigezo ekimu ekyenjawulo, kubanga engeri omuntu oyo gy’akiyitamu yandituukirizza ekintu ekitandisobose kutuukirizibwa mu ngeri ndala yonna. Mu kizikiza ekyo, yasalawo okuddamu nti weewaawo eri ekibuuzo ekyo. Era ekyo kyafuuka omusingi gw’obuweereza bw’okwogera n’okuwandiika obwayamba Abakristaayo emitwalo n’emitwalo okwetegereza okubonaabona kwabwe bennyini.

Endowooza ya Roseveare ku muminsani ng’omuntu asitudde ekyobugagga mu kibya ekimenyese yava butereevu mu ngeri Pawulo yennyini gye yannyonnyolamu obuweereza bw’abatume: “Naye kaakano tulina ekyobugagga kino mu bibya eby’ebbumba, okulaga nti obuyinza bwonna bwa Katonda, so si bwaffe. Tunyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye ne tutabetenteka. Ne tweraliikirira, naye ne tutazirika. Tuyigganyizibwa, naye Katonda tatuleka. Tusuulibwa wansi, naye ne tutabetentuka” (2 Abakkolinso 4:7–9). Ekyobugagga ekyo, ye njiri.

Ekibya eky’ebbumba yali ye — omusawo Omungereza alina obunafu bwonna, obutaba na bukuumi, n’okumenyeka omubiri gw’omuntu kwe gulina. Obunafu bwe bwennyini ye yali ensonga: bwalaga lwatu nti amaanyi ag’ekitalo ag’ebyali bibeerawo mu Kongo tegaali gage.

Okutegeera kwe nti okubonaabona kwe kugabana ku bibonoobono bya Kristo kwamuwa omusingi gw’okutegeera obukambwe bwe yayitamu, n’asobola okubukkiriza awatali kuzikiriza kukkiriza kwe. Mu bigambo bya Pawulo eby’ekitalo eri Abafiripi teyalabamu kwagala kwebonyaabonya, wabula enjigiriza y’obuminsani ey’amaanyi ennyo: “Njagala okussa ekimu mu bibonoobono bye, nga mmufaanana mu kufa kwe, mmumanye era ntegeere amaanyi g’okuzuukira kwe” (Abafiripi 3:10). Bye baakola omubiri gwe mu 1964, yatuuka n’okukkiriza nti byali kipimo ky’okusemberera Katonda kwe yamuganya okugabana ku ebyo Kristo yennyini bye yayitamu: obukambwe n’okwabulirwa.

Teyali nti awona buwonyi kintu. Yali agabanako ku kintu.

Okusalawo kwe okuddayo mu Kongo ng’amaze okuva mu buwambe kuyinza okuba nga kye kikolwa ky’obuminsani ekyasinga okweyoleka mu bulamu bwe bwonna obw’okuweereza. Yalina buli nsonga ey’obuntu ey’okusigala mu Bungereza. Yali akoleddwako ebikolwa eby’obukambwe era ng’alumiziddwa nnyo mu mwoyo. Eggwanga lyali likyalimu akabi. Tewali n’omu yandimunenyezza olw’okusigala.

Naye yali awulidde omulanga ogw’enjawulo ogw’okugenda mu kifo ekimu ekyenjawulo, era obukambwe bwe yayitamu mu kifo ekyo tebwasazaamu mulanga ogwo. Mu bigambo bya Peetero mwe yasanga olukusa lwe yali yeetaaga okuddayo: “Abaagalwa, temwewuunya obulumi obw’amaanyi bwe bubatuukako ng’abatuukiddwako ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo. Kyokka musanyuke kubanga mugabanye ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo, mulyoke mujjule essanyu, ng’ekitiibwa kye kirabise.” (1 Peetero 4:12–13). Yali agabanye ku kubonaabona. Ekitiibwa kyali kikyajja. Yaddayo asobole okubaawo nga kirabise.

Omusika Roseveare gwe yalekera ekkanisa mu kutegeera okwefiiriza mu buminsani gwali gwa kufuula okubonaabona ekintu ekiyinza okwogerwako — okuwa ebigambo eri ekintu abaminsani abasinga obungi kye baaziikanga mu kusirika, oba kye baanyirizanga ne bakifuula eky’obuwanguzi ekisanyusa okuwulira. Yayogeranga ku kumenyeka kwe nga tatya, era bwe yakola bw’atyo n’awa enkumi n’enkumi z’abalala olukusa okukkiriza okumenyeka kwabwe. Yali azudde Pawulo ky’ayogerako ng’okubala kw’enjiri okusinga okukontana n’endowooza y’omuntu: “kubanga buli bwe mba omunafu, olwo nga ndi wa maanyi” (2 Abakkolinso 12:10). Omuminsani eyakkiriza obunafu bwe teyakendeeza ku bujulirwa bwe. Mu kukkiriza okwo kwennyini, ye yali asinga okwolesa amaanyi agataali gage.

Essaala

Mukama, eyamenyebwa ku lwaffe, tuyigirize obutanyooma kumenyeka. Bwe tukweka ebiwundu byaffe ne tweraga ng’abalina amaanyi, tuwe obwesimbu bwa Roseveare. Okubonaabona bwe kutiisatiisa okuzikiriza okukkiriza kwaffe, kuleke kukwongere buziba mu kifo ky’okukuzikiriza. Tuwe ekisa okubuuza, wamu naye, oba nga tusobola okukwebaza olw’okutwesiga n’ebintu ebizibu — n’ekisa okukitegeeza ddala bwe tuddamu nti weewaawo. Amiina.

fields.title: Jim Elliot — Omujulizi Eyafuna Ky’Atasobola Kufiirwa
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Philip James Elliot yazaalibwa nga 8 Okitobba, 1927, mu Portland, Oregon. Kitaawe yali mubuulizi mu kibiina kya Plymouth Brethren, ate nnyina yalina okukkiriza okw’amaanyi okwabumba obuto bwe bwonna. Yatikkirwa mu Wheaton College mu 1949, gye yali omuzannyi w’okumeggana eyawangulanga, era omuyizi ng’obunyiikivu bwe mu by’omwoyo bwali butandise okulabibwa abantu. Mu 1952 yasaabala n’agenda e Ecuador, n’ayiga olulimi Oluquechua, n’atandika okukola mu bantu ba Quechua mu kibira ky’e Ecuador wamu ne mukyala we Elisabeth Howard, gwe yawasa mu 1953. Yagenda yeeyongera okumalibwamu okwegomba okutuuka ku Bahuaorani (mu biseera ebyo abaayitibwanga Aucas) — eggwanga eryali limanyiddwa olw’okulwanyisa n’obukambwe abantu bonna abava ebweru, era nga teribuulirwangako njiri n’akatono. Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi mingi nga basuula ebirabo okuva mu nnyonyi okubafuula ab’omukwano, ye n’abaminsani banne bana — Nate Saint, Roger Youderian, Pete Fleming, ne Ed McCully — ne bagwa ku lubalama lw’omugga Curaray nga 3 Jjanwali, 1956. Oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ttaano, nga 8 Jjanwali, 1956, bonna abataano ne battibwa abalwanyi b’Abahuaorani n’amafumu. Jim Elliot yali wa myaka abiri mu munaana. Ebyo bye yawandiikanga buli lunaku, Elisabeth bye yafulumya oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe, byalimu sentensi eyafuuka akabonero k’obulamu bwe: “Si musirusiru oyo agaba ky’atasobola kukuuma, afune ky’atasobola kufiirwa.”

Okulaba kwe ku Buweereza bw’Obuminsani n’Okwefiiriza

Jim Elliot okutegeera kwe ku kwefiiriza mu buminsani kwabumbibwa nga tannaba na kulinnya ku ttaka ly’e Ecuador — kwabumbibwa mu myaka gye egy’ettendekero, ng’afumiitiriza bulijjo ku bigambo bya Yesu ebikwata ku muwendo gw’okuba omuyigirizwa n’engeri y’obwakabaka. Bwe yali atikkirwa mu Wheaton, yali amaze okusalawo nti obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’eddembe, obukuumibwa, obwekuuma bwokka, abasinga obungi ku banne ab’omulembe gwe bwe baali banoonya, tebwakwatagana n’ebyo ebikakali Kristo bye yasaba, Kristo gwe yasomangako mu Njiri. Si buli muntu nti yayitibwa okugenda e Ecuador. Naye buli muntu yayitibwa okwewaayo okwa byonna, Ecuador kwe kwamwetaagisa.

Sentensi ye eyo emanyiddwa ennyo mu bye yawandiika — “Si musirusiru oyo agaba ky’atasobola kukuuma, afune ky’atasobola kufiirwa” — yali ngeri Elliot gye yaddamu mu bigambo bye ye endowooza ya Yesu yennyini: “Kubanga buli ayagala okulokola obulamu bwe, alibufiirwa. Na buli alifiirwa obulamu bwe ku lwange alibulokola. Kubanga omuntu kirimugasa ki okulya ensi yonna, naye n’afiirwa obulamu bwe?” (Lukka 9:24–25). Elliot yali abaze okubala Yesu kwe yawa, n’atuuka ku kusalawo kwe kumu.

Obulamu bw’okuuma ng’obwekuuma bwe bulamu bw’ofiirwa. Obulamu bw’ofiirwa ng’ogondera Kristo bwe bulamu bwokka obutayinza kukuggibwako. Ku lubalama lw’omugga Curaray teyali muntu atafaayo. Yali alowooza bulungi, n’amagezi ensi eyamwetoolodde ge yali tesobola kubala.

Elliot era yali ayize enjigiriza y’empeke y’eŋŋaano mu bujjuvu nnyo, ekyafuula okufa kwe obutaba kabenje wabula okusiga. Yali amanyi nti abasajja abataano abaafiira ku lubalama lw’omugga Curaray si be baali ekigambo ekisembayo mu byafaayo by’Abahuaorani; baali kigambo kisooka. Empeke yali erina okugwa mu ttaka amakungula nga tegannajja. Era gajja: mu myaka esatu oluvannyuma lw’okuttibwa kwabwe, Elisabeth Elliot ne Rachel Saint baali babeera mu Bahuaorani, era abasajja abatta Jim — nga mw’otwalidde n’oyo eyali akutte effumu — oluvannyuma ne bafuuka Abakristaayo abakkiriza. Mincaye, omu ku batta Jim, yafuuka omukadde eyayagalibwa ennyo mu kkanisa y’Abahuaorani, era bwe yayogera ku kufa kwa Jim yagamba nti: “Twakola bubi, bubi nnyo. Katonda n’akifuula kirungi.” Ekisuubizo kya Yesu kyali kituukiridde: “naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi” (Yokaana 12:24). Yali ebaze ebibala bingi. Ate n’okutuusa kati ekyabibala.

Emboozi y’okufa kwe — Elisabeth gye yanyumya mu kitabo Through Gates of Splendour — yaleetawo erimu ku mayengo agasinga obukulu ag’abantu abeewaayo okugenda mu buminsani mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri.

fields.title: Elisabeth Elliot — Nnamwandu Eyaddayo eri Abaatta Bba
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Elisabeth Howard Elliot yazaalibwa nga 21 Ddesemba 1926, mu Brussels, mu Bubirigi, nga muwala wa Philip Howard, omusasi w’amawulire Omukristaayo, ne Katharine Gillingham, era bombi baali baana b’abaminsani. Yasoma Oluyonaani olw’edda mu Wheaton College, gye yasisinkanira Jim Elliot gwe yafumbirwa oluvannyuma, n’asaabala okugenda e Ecuador mu 1952, n’atandika omulimu gw’olulimi mu bantu ab’eggwanga lya Quechua. Jim n’abaminsani abalala bana bwe battibwa Abahuaorani nga 8 Janwali 1956, Elisabeth yali wa myaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, ng’alina omwana omuwala ow’emyezi kkumi, Valerie. Emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma, mu 1958, ye ne Rachel Saint, mwannyina wa Nate Saint (omu ku baminsani abattibwa), baagenda okubeera mu kitundu ky’Abahuaorani nga bali ne Valerie — nga agenda kubeera wakati mu ggwanga eryali litte bba. Yamalayo emyaka ebiri, n’alaba abantu bangi nga bakyuka ne badda eri Kristo mu Bahuaorani — nga mw’otwalidde n’abasajja abaafumita Jim amafumu — n’addayo mu Amerika, gye yamalira emyaka amakumi ataano egyaddirira ng’awandiika era ng’ayogera ku njigiriza y’okubonaabona, ey’obuwulize, n’ey’obulamu obwewaddeyo. Yawandiika ebitabo ebisukka mu abiri, nga mw’otwalidde “Through Gates of Splendour,” “Shadow of the Almighty,” ne “Through Suffering.”

Yafa mu 2015 ng’alina emyaka kinaana mu munaana.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Buweereza obw’Obuminsani n’Okwewaayo

Ekyo Elisabeth Elliot kye yagattako ku njigiriza y’okwewaayo mu buminsani kyali kya njawulo ku kya bba, wadde nga tebyawukanika. Okufa kwa Jim ng’omujulizi kwali ensigo ey’ekyewuunyo; okusalawo kwa Elisabeth okuddayo eri Abahuaorani kwe kwali obukakafu obusirifu nti ensigo eyo yali efudde ddala era ng’ezaala obulamu. Okuddayo kwe kwe kwali ekikolwa ky’obuminsani ekyasinga okwogera mu lugero lwonna olw’Abahuaorani: kyalangirira, n’amaanyi agasinga ag’okubuulira kwonna, nti enjiri gye yali asitudde teyali ndowooza bundowooza, wabula maanyi agava eri Katonda agasobola okuzaala okwagala okusukka ensalo y’abantu esinga obukakali — ensalo eri wakati w’attiddwa n’omutemu.

Enjigiriza eyali emabega w’okuddayo kwa Elisabeth yali enjigiriza y’okwagala abalabe. Teyali akweese nnaku ye wadde ebiwundu by’omutima gwe; yali abireese eri Katonda, n’afuna mu kifo kyabyo omulanga gwe yali tasobola kunnyonnyola mu ngeri ya buntu. Abantu abaali batte bba, yali mukakafu nti, be bantu Katonda be yali amutuma okutuukako. Ekiragiro kya Yesu yali akitwala nga kikulu ddala: “Naye nze mbagamba nti, Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe! Musabirenga ababayigganya! Bwe mulikola bwe mutyo muliba baana ba Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.” (Matayo 5:44–45). Kino tekyali kwewulira bwewulizi wadde okwolesa. Bwali buwulize — obuwulize obw’ebbeeyi, obw’okwesalirawo, obuva eri Katonda, eri ekiragiro omutima gw’omuntu kye gutasobola kutuukiriza awatali maanyi ga Mwoyo.

Omulimu gwa Elisabeth ogw’okuwandiika ogwaddirira gwazimbibwa ku kukkiriza nti omulanga ogw’okwewaayo mu buminsani tegwali gwa kibira kya Ecuador kyokka wadde olubalama abajulizi gye baafiira, wabula gwe mulanga ogwa bulijjo ogwa buli Mukristaayo mu buli mbeera. “Ekkubo ekkakali” ery’obuwulize — ebigambo bye yakozesanga ku kulonda omulanga gwa Katonda okusinga ekkubo eddala eryangu ennyo — lyeyolekanga buli lunaku: mu kusalawo okw’emirimu, mu kulonda okw’enkolagana, mu ssaddaaka ey’ensimbi, mu nsalo y’obuwangwa esomokebwa olw’enjiri. Yali azudde mu kwegayirira kwa Pawulo eri ekkanisa y’e Rooma omusingi gw’okwewaayo kuno okw’obuminsani okujjuvu: “Noolwekyo abooluganda mbeegayirira olw’okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwengayo emibiri gyammwe nga ssaddaaka ennamu entukuvu esanyusa Katonda, kwe kuweereza kwammwe okw’omwoyo.” (Abaruumi 12:1). Ssaddaaka ennamu. Si kufa ng’omujulizi okw’ekyewuunyo, wabula okwewaayo kw’omuntu yenna eri ebigendererwa bya Katonda buli lunaku, ng’azuukuse, ng’assa omukka.

Yali alaba bulungi ddala omuwendo gw’obulamu bw’obuminsani, era teyakkiriza kubwogerako ng’olugero olunyuma olw’ekirooto.

Yali afiiriddwa Jim. Yali akuzizza omwana omuwala yekka. Yali abeeredde wamu n’eggwanga mu mbeera abantu abasinga obungi mwe batandiyingidde kyeyagalire wadde okukyalako olunaku lumu. Teyeefuula nti kino kyonna kyali kyangu, oba nti yawulira ng’omuzira mu kukikola. Kye yawa obujulirwa kyali nti Katonda yali mwesigwa wakati mu byonna — nti ekisuubizo ky’oluyimba lwa Isaaya olukulu olw’okununulibwa kyali kikakasiddwa mu bulamu bwe: “Bw’onooyitanga mu mazzi amawanvu nnaabeeranga naawe, ne bw’onooyitanga mu migga tegirikusaanyaawo; bw’onooyitanga mu muliro tegukwokyenga, ennimi z’omuliro tezirikwokya.” (Isaaya 43:2). Yali ayise mu mazzi. Teyali asaanyiziddwawo. Era yamala emyaka amakumi ana ng’abuulira ekkanisa nti ekisuubizo ekyo kyesigika.

Ekyo Elisabeth Elliot kye yasembayo okuwaayo, era oboolyawo ekisinga okukebera omutima, ku njigiriza y’okwewaayo mu buminsani kyali okunyweza kwe nti obuwulize kye kibuuzo ekisooka. Si kuwulira, si mbeera, si kubalirira biyinza kuvaamu — wabula okusalawo okwangu, okwa buli lunaku, okw’ebbeeyi, okugondera Katonda kye yayogera, n’okumwesiga mu ebyo ebinaavaamu. Yali azudde mu kitabo ky’Engero endowooza eyasobozesa kino: “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.” (Engero 3:5–6).

Teyali ategedde kkubo eryayita mu kufa kwa Jim ne limuyingiza mu kitundu ky’Abahuaorani. Teyasabibwa kulitegeera. Yasabibwa kwesiga n’okugenda. N’akikola. Era Katonda n’aluŋŋamya ekkubo — ne limutuusa butereevu mu mitima gy’abantu bennyini abaali bayimiridde ku nkomerero yaalyo nga bakutte amafumu.

Essaala

Mukama w’ebitasoboka, tuwe obwagazi bwa Elisabeth obw’okugondera nga tetunnategeera, okugenda ng’ekkubo terinnaba kweyoleka, n’okwagala omulabe ng’okuwulira okw’okwagala tekunnajja. Bwe tufuula okutegeera okuba obukwakkulizo bw’obuwulize, tuyigirize okusooka okugondera n’okwesiga nti Ggwe ojja kutangaaza ekkubo nga tulitambuliramu. Tuwe emitima egitaliiko muntu gwe gisuula ebbali mu kwagala kw’olagira — wadde omuntu oyo eyasinga okutulumya. Amiina.
