Yali ayise mu mazzi. Teyali asaanyiziddwawo. Era yamala emyaka amakumi ana ng’abuulira ekkanisa nti ekisuubizo ekyo kyesigika. Ekyo Elisabeth Elliot kye yasembayo okuwaayo, era oboolyawo ekisinga okukebera omutima, ku njigiriza y’okwewaayo mu buminsani kyali okunyweza kwe nti obuwulize kye kibuuzo ekisooka. Si kuwulira, si mbeera, si kubalirira biyinza kuvaamu — wabula okusalawo okwangu, okwa buli lunaku, okw’ebbeeyi, okugondera Katonda kye yayogera, n’okumwesiga mu ebyo ebinaavaamu. Yali azudde mu kitabo ky’Engero endowooza eyasobozesa kino: “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.” (Engero 3:5–6). Teyali ategedde kkubo eryayita mu kufa kwa Jim ne limuyingiza mu kitundu ky’Abahuaorani. Teyasabibwa kulitegeera. Yasabibwa kwesiga n’okugenda. N’akikola. Era Katonda n’aluŋŋamya ekkubo — ne limutuusa butereevu mu mitima gy’abantu bennyini abaali bayimiridde ku nkomerero yaalyo nga bakutte amafumu. Essaala Mukama w’ebitasoboka, tuwe obwagazi bwa Elisabeth obw’okugondera nga tetunnategeera, okugenda ng’ekkubo terinnaba kweyoleka, n’okwagala omulabe ng’okuwulira okw’okwagala tekunnajja. Bwe tufuula okutegeera okuba obukwakkulizo bw’obuwulize, tuyigirize okusooka okugondera n’okwesiga nti Ggwe ojja kutangaaza ekkubo nga tulitambuliramu. Tuwe emitima egitaliiko muntu gwe gisuula ebbali mu kwagala kw’olagira — wadde omuntu oyo eyasinga okutulumya. Amiina.

fields.title: Okufundikira: Ekiragiro Tekisaziddwamu
fields.body_html:
Kati omaze ekiseera n’obulamu bw’abantu kkumi, obwo bwe bugattibwa awamu, ne buba ensonga ey’amaanyi ennyo ewakanya Obukristaayo obw’okwewummuliza, nga kizibu okugiddamu. William Carey yawaayo emyaka amakumi ana mu gumu eri Buyindi, era teyaddayo ka. David Livingstone yawaayo omutima gwe eri Afirika — mu bigambo ebya ddala, kubanga abaweereza be baaguziika mu ttaka lya Zambia. Catherine Booth yatwala enjiri mu mbaawo z’omwenge n’ebifo by’abaavu ebya London mu biseera bya Victoria, ng’eno bw’alera abaana munaana. D.L. Moody yabuulira abantu obukadde kikumi, ng’atandikidde ku busa, ng’omutunzi w’engatto atalina diguli yonna mu by’eddiini.

Pandita Ramabai yaleka ekitiibwa ekisingayo mu by’amagezi Buyindi kye yali ewadde omukazi, n’amala emyaka amakumi ana egyaddirira ng’adduukirira abasinga okunyoomebwa mu Buyindi era ng’avvuunula Bayibuli mu lulimi lwabwe. C.T. Studd yagaba pawundi emitwalo ebiri mu kenda, n’agenda ku ssemazinga basatu. John Stott yagaba ensimbi ze yafunanga mu bitabo bye, n’abeera mu kasenge akamu, era n’ateekateeka ekkanisa y’omu nsi ez’omu Bukiikaddyo bw’ensi okumala ekyasa kiramba. Helen Roseveare yaddayo eri abantu abaali bamukoze ebikolwa eby’obukambwe n’ensonyi. Jim Elliot yafiira ku lubalama lw’omugga mu Ecuador ng’aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu munaana, ng’awaddeyo byonna bye yalina. Elisabeth Elliot yagenda okubeera n’abatemu ba bba, n’alaba Katonda ng’abakyusa ne bakkiriza.

Obulamu ng’obwo obukolera ki? Kye kimu ky’okolera Ekiragiro Ekikulu ekyabuzaala: okitwala nga kikulu ddala. Si ng’ekiwandiiko eky’ebyafaayo ekinyuma obunyumi, si ng’omulimu gw’abakulembeze b’eddiini abaatendekebwa bokka, si ng’ensibuko y’emboozi ezizzaamu amaanyi ez’okusoma olumu na lumu — wabula ng’ekiragiro ekiramu ekyaweebwa Mukama eyazuukira eri buli muntu yenna eyeeyita omuyigirizwa We, mu buli mulembe, okutuusa ku gusembayo. Ekiragiro tekisaziddwamu. Eby’okukungula bikyali bingi. Abakozi bakyali batono. Enkomerero z’ensi zikyali tezinnatuukibwako.

Era n’ekisuubizo ekyajja awamu n’ekiragiro tekikyusiddwa wadde okukendeezebwako. Kristo oyo eyatuma abasajja n’abakazi bano ekkumi ye Kristo oyo akutuma ggwe — era ekisuubizo kye kimu ekyabanyweza kinyweza buli muntu atwala ekiragiro kye nga kikulu: “Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo” (Matayo 28:20). Bulijjo. Okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero. Si nti “okutuusa omulimu lwe guliba omuzibu,” si nti “okutuusa abantu b’omu nsi lwe balikukyawa,” si nti “okutuusa obulamu bwo lwe bulinafuwa oba ebyo by’olina lwe biriggwaawo.” Bulijjo. Carey yakikakasa okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu gumu mu Buyindi. Roseveare yakikakasa ng’ali mu busibe e Kongo. Livingstone yakikakasa ng’afukamidde mu kasiisira k’ebitosi e Zambia. Ekisuubizo kino kirina obujulizi obukakafu.

Oboolyawo osoma ekitabo kino ng’omuntu eyamala okutumibwa — omuminsani, omubuulizi w’enjiri, omusomesa wa Bayibuli akolera mu kifo ekikusasuza ekintu ekya ddala buli lunaku. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, obulamu buno ekkumi be banno, n’obujulizi bwabwe bwe buzzaamu amaanyi. Si ggwe osoose okusanga omulimu nga muzibu, ennimiro nga nkakanyavu, ne ssaddaaka nga ya ddala. Buli omu ku bano ekkumi yayita mu ebyo byennyini.

Tewali n’omu ku bo eyadda emabega. Katonda eyabanyweza ye akunyweza ggwe.

Oboolyawo osoma kino ng’omuntu atannafumiitiriza nnyo ku kibuuzo ky’ekyo Ekiragiro Ekikulu kye kikusaba ggwe ddala. Ekibuuzo ekyo kisaanidde okuddibwamu mu mazima. Si mu ndowooza obuzzi, si mu by’ensimbi ebikoma ku kuwaayo ekirabo n’okuwulira nti otuukirizza obuvunaanyizibwa, wabula mu kufumiitiriza okwa ddala, okw’okusaba, era okukusaamu omuwendo, ku ekyo Katonda ky’akusaba ku bulamu obumu bwokka bwe waweebwa. C.T. Studd yandikyogedde mu bigambo ebyangu: “Obulamu bumu bwokka, bujja kuggwaako mangu; ebyo byokka ebikoleddwa ku lwa Kristo bye birisigalawo.”

Empeke y’eŋŋaano ekyayitibwa okugwa mu ttaka. Ensonga eri mu bigambo bya Jim Elliot ebisinga okumanyika ekyali ya mazima: obulamu obuweereddwayo ku lwa Kristo bwe bulamu bwokka obutayinza kuggibwako.

Ekiragiro ekyaweebwa emyaka enkumi bbiri emabega ku lusozi e Ggaliraaya kikyali kye kiwandiiko ekitegeka obulamu bw’ekkanisa bwonna. Era Oyo eyakiwa akyali, mu kaseera kano kennyini, ng’agamba buli muyigirizwa anaawuliriza nti: “Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe” (Yokaana 20:21).

Ekibuuzo kyokka kye kino: tunaagenda oba nedda?

“Naye obulamu bwange sibutwala kuba nga kya muwendo gye ndi, ndyoke ntuukirize omulimu gwange, n’obuweereza bwe nnaweebwa Mukama waffe Yesu, okutegeezanga Enjiri ey’ekisa kya Katonda.”

— Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:24

fields.title: Ebyawandiikibwa Ebyongerezeddwako: Ekigambo kya Katonda ku Bulamu bw’Obuminsani
fields.body_html:
Ebyawandiikibwa bino wammanga ebikwata ku buminsani, okubuulira enjiri, okwewaayo nga ssaddaaka, n’okugaba, bijuliziddwa mu kitabo kino kyonna. Ebigambo byonna ebijuliziddwa biggiddwa mu Bayibuli y’Oluganda ey’Omulembe (Open Luganda Contemporary Bible, OLCB), okuggyako ng’ekirala kiragiddwa.

Ennyanjula

Matayo 28:19–20 — “Kale mugende mufuule abantu bonna mu nsi zonna, abayigirizwa nga mubabatiza mu linnya lya Kitaffe, Omwana era Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe, era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8 — “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”

Abaruumi 10:14–15 — “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa? Ekyawandiikibwa nga bwe kigamba nti, ‘Ebigere by’abo abategeeza amawulire amalungi, nga birungi.’”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:24 — “Naye obulamu bwange sibutwala kuba nga kya muwendo gye ndi, ndyoke ntuukirize omulimu gwange, n’obuweereza bwe nnaweebwa Mukama waffe Yesu, okutegeezanga Enjiri ey’ekisa kya Katonda.”

Essuula 1 — William Carey

Kaabakuuku 2:14 — “Kubanga ensi erijjula okumanya ekitiibwa kya Mukama, ng’amazzi bwe ganjaala ku nnyanja.”

Matayo 28:20 — “Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe.”

Yobu 23:10 — “Naye amanyi amakubo mwe mpita, bw’anaamala okungezesa, nzija kuvaamu nga zaabu.”

Isaaya 55:11 — “Bwe kityo ekigambo kyange ekiva mu kamwa kange bwe kiri; tekiriddayo bwereere, naye kirikola ekyo kye njagala era kirituukiriza ekyo kye nakituma.”

Yokaana 20:21 — “Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe.”

Essuula 2 — David Livingstone

Isaaya 49:6 — “Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo. Nzija kukufuula ekitangaala eri abamawanga, olyoke oleete obulokozi bwange eri ensi yonna.”

2 Abakkolinso 4:8–9 — “Tunyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye ne tutabetenteka. Ne tweraliikirira, naye ne tutazirika. Tuyigganyizibwa, naye Katonda tatuleka. Tusuulibwa wansi, naye ne tutabetentuka.”

Engero 31:8–9 — “Yogereranga abo abatasobola kweyogerera, otunulenga mu nsonga z’abo bonna abaasigala ettayo. Yogera olamulenga n’obwenkanya, olwanirirenga abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu.”

Yokaana 1:14 — “Kigambo n’afuuka omubiri, n’abeera mu ffe.”

Matayo 28:20 — “Era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo.”

Essuula 3 — Catherine Booth

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:17–18 — “Olulituuka mu nnaku ez’oluvannyuma, bw’ayogera Katonda, ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku balina omubiri bonna. Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe baliwa obunnabbi; n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa, n’abakadde baliroota ebirooto. Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange, ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi; baliwa obunnabbi.”

Lukka 4:18–19 — “Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze. Anfuseeko amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri. Antumye okubuulira abasibe okuteebwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso okuzibulwa amaaso balabe, n’abanyigirizibwa okufuna eddembe, n’okulangirira ekiseera kya Mukama eky’okulagiramu ekisa kye.”

1 Yokaana 3:17–18 — “Buli alina ebintu eby’omu nsi n’alaba muganda we nga yeetaaga, naye n’abulwako ky’amuwa, okwagala kwa Katonda, kuyinza kutya okuba mu ye? Abaana abaagalwa, tetusaana kwagala mu bigambo kyokka, wabula twagalanenga ne mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu.”

2 Abakkolinso 5:14–15 — “Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa. Yafiirira abantu bonna; abalamu balemenga okubeera abalamu ku bwabwe bokka, wabula ku bw’oyo eyabafiirira era n’azuukira.”

1 Abakkolinso 9:16 — “Kubanga bwe mbuulira Enjiri sisobola kwenyumiriza, kubanga mpalirizibwa okugibuulira. Era ziba zinsanze bwe sigibuulira.”

Essuula 4 — D.L. Moody

Yokaana 3:16 — “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8 — “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”

2 Timoseewo 2:2 — “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala.”

2 Abakkolinso 9:6 — “Naye mujjukire nti, Asiga ekitono alikungula kitono, naye asiga ekinene alikungula kinene.”

Abafiripi 1:21 — “Nze mba mulamu lwa Kristo era ne bwe nfa mba ngobolodde.”

Essuula 5 — Pandita Ramabai

Yakobo 1:27 — “Eddiini entuufu etaliiko bbala mu maaso ga Katonda Kitaffe, y’eyo ey’omuntu alabirira bamulekwa ne bannamwandu era nga yeekuuma ensi gy’alimu ereme kumuletako bbala.”

Yoweeri 2:28–29 — “Awo olulituuka oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku bantu bonna. Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe balitegeeza eby’omu maaso; abakadde baliroota ebirooto, n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa.

Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi.”

Isaaya 40:8 — “Omuddo guwotoka, ekimuli kiyongobera, naye ekigambo kya Katonda waffe kibeerera emirembe gyonna.”

Abafiripi 3:7–8 — “Naye ebyo byonna ebyali omugabo gye ndi, nabiraba nga butaliimu. Naye okusinga byonna, byonna mbiraba ng’okufiirwa, kubanga okutegeera Kristo Yesu Mukama wange, kusinga ebirala byonna. Olwa Kristo nafiirwa ebintu byonna.”

Essuula 6 — C.T. Studd

Matayo 19:21 — “Obanga oyagala okuba omutuukirivu genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu, kale oliba n’obugagga mu ggulu, olyoke ojje ongoberere.”

Yokaana 12:24 — “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi.”

Abaruumi 15:20 — “Nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo, nneme okuzimba ku musingi gw’omuntu omulala.”

Abaruumi 8:18 — “Okubonaabona kwe tubonaabona kaakano kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa.”

Essuula 7 — John Stott

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 17:23 — “Kubanga bwe mbadde ntambulatambula ne ndaba ebyoto bya ssaddaaka bingi, ne ku kimu nga kuliko ebigambo bino nti: Kya Katonda Atamanyiddwa. Mubadde mumusinza nga temumumanyi, nange kaakano njagala mbamutegeeze.”

Matayo 28:20 — “Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe.”

2 Timoseewo 2:2 — “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala.”

Matayo 6:19–20 — “Temweterekeranga byabugagga wano ku nsi kwe biyinza okwonoonebwa ennyenje n’obutalagge, n’ababbi kwe bayinza okubibbira. Naye mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe mu ggulu.”

Ebigambo byonna ebijuliziddwa biggiddwa mu Bayibuli y’Oluganda ey’Omulembe (Open Luganda Contemporary Bible, OLCB), okuggyako ng’ekirala kiragiddwa. Ennyanjula Matayo 28:19–20 — “Kale mugende mufuule abantu bonna mu nsi zonna, abayigirizwa nga mubabatiza mu linnya lya Kitaffe, Omwana era Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa? Ekyawandiikibwa nga bwe kigamba nti, ‘Ebigere by’abo abategeeza amawulire amalungi, nga birungi.’” Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:24 — “Naye obulamu bwange sibutwala kuba nga kya muwendo gye ndi, ndyoke ntuukirize omulimu gwange, n’obuweereza bwe nnaweebwa Mukama waffe Yesu, okutegeezanga Enjiri ey’ekisa kya Katonda.” Essuula 1 — William Carey Kaabakuuku 2:14 — “Kubanga ensi erijjula okumanya ekitiibwa kya Mukama, ng’amazzi bwe ganjaala ku nnyanja.” Matayo 28:20 — “Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe.” Yobu 23:10 — “Naye amanyi amakubo mwe mpita, bw’anaamala okungezesa, nzija kuvaamu nga zaabu.” Isaaya 55:11 — “Bwe kityo ekigambo kyange ekiva mu kamwa kange bwe kiri; tekiriddayo bwereere, naye kirikola ekyo kye njagala era kirituukiriza ekyo kye nakituma.” Yokaana 20:21 — “Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe.” Essuula 2 — David Livingstone Isaaya 49:6 — “Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo.
